plot_acts.zh: 从和歌与能乐理论出发，处理「深远、余情、不可言说」这一组难度最高的审美经验。上游是世阿弥《风姿花传》。
plot_acts.en: From waka and Noh theory, it handles the hardest cluster — depth, lingering overtones, the unsayable. Its upstream is Zeami's Fūshikaden.

plot_acts.zh: 从《源氏物语》与本居宣长的诠释出发，把「知物之情」确立为前道德的审美感应。
plot_acts.en: From The Tale of Genji and Motoori's reading, it establishes the 'knowing of things' as a pre-moral aesthetic attunement.

plot_acts.zh: 从茶道与俳谐出发，析「寂」的时间性与枯淡结构；《日本侘寂》即此论的通俗单行。
plot_acts.en: From tea and haikai, it analyses sabi's temporality and structure of plainness; the standalone Japanese Wabi-Sabi is its popular issue.

craft.zh: 统一骨架，三种刀法：同一方法在三论中反复使用，差异处正是范畴的个性。
craft.en: One skeleton, three cuts: the same method recurs, and the differences are each category's individuality.

craft.zh: 概念史优先：不先定义，而先追词在历史中的用法变化。
craft.en: Conceptual history first: no definition before tracking the word's historical shifts.

craft.zh: 以西释日：用德国美学范畴给日本词立法，优点是可比较，风险是削足适履。
craft.en: Explaining Japan with the West: German categories legislate for Japanese words — comparable, at the risk of Procrustean fit.

motifs.evid_zh: 深远而不可尽言的美，源于能乐与和歌。
motifs.evid_en: A beauty deep and never fully spoken, from Noh and waka.

motifs.evid_zh: 见物而心动的感应，先于善恶判断。

motifs.evid_zh: 时间沉积出的枯淡与静。
motifs.evid_en: The plainness and stillness time deposits.

excerpts.trans_zh: 三论共用一套骨架：词源、用例、结构、边界。合读的价值在比较。同一位美学家用同一把刀处理幽玄、物哀、寂，刀法在哪里变了，正说明范畴本身在抵抗被定义。
excerpts.trans_en: The three studies share one skeleton: etymology, usage, structure, boundary. Their value together is comparative. One aesthetician applies one knife to yugen, mono no aware and sabi; where the cutting changes, the category itself is resisting definition.
excerpts.source: 《幽玄·物哀·寂》三部曲》论旨概述 · 据出版说明与通行引述（非逐字）

deep_read.zh: 三论各读结论，先建立三个范畴的边界，再回读论证，效率最高。
deep_read.en: Read each study's conclusion first to fix the three boundaries, then return to the arguments — the most efficient order.

deep_read.zh: 把「幽玄」与《风姿花传》对读：大西是在给世阿弥的实践做理论化。
deep_read.en: Read yūgen against Fūshikaden: Onishi is theorising Zeami's practice.

deep_read.zh: 注意译本序里「美学」作为译词的历史，这会改变你对「日本美学」这一说法的理解。
deep_read.en: Note the history of 'aesthetics' as a translated term in the preface; it changes how you hear 'Japanese aesthetics'.

books.why_zh: 特辑三册美学背后的中文系统论著：幽玄、物哀、寂各成一论，是「审美范畴论」的典范。
books.why_en: The systematic Chinese work behind the Special's three aesthetic volumes: yūgen, aware and sabi each get a study — a model of category-aesthetics.

background.zh: 大西克礼（1888—1959）的「幽玄」论、「物哀」论、「寂」论原为三部独立研究，中译本由王向远合为一卷，2017 年由上海译文出版社出版，属「日本文学经典文学」一类丛书。三论分别对应中世能乐与和歌（幽玄）、平安物语与本居宣长（物哀）、茶道与俳谐（寂）。大西的方法是概念史加美学结构分析：先追词义与用例，再析其审美契机。
background.en: Onishi Yoshinori's (1888–1959) studies of yūgen, mono no aware and sabi were three separate monographs; Wang Xiangyuan's Chinese version gathers them in one volume (Shanghai Translation, 2017). They correspond to medieval Noh and waka (yūgen), Heian narrative and Motoori Norinaga (aware), and tea and haikai (sabi). Onishi's method is conceptual history plus structural aesthetics: etymology and usage first, then the aesthetic moments.

narrative.zh: 三论共用一套骨架：词源—用例—结构—边界。合读的价值在于比较：同一个美学家如何用同一把刀处理三个不同时代的范畴，哪些地方刀法变了，正说明范畴本身的抵抗。
narrative.en: The three share one skeleton: etymology, usage, structure, boundary. Their value together is comparative: watch the same aesthetician use the same knife on categories from three different eras; where the cut changes, the category is resisting.

intent.reception_good_zh: 中文世界第一次把大西的三论系统译出，王向远的译本序把「美学」作为外来学科在日本的确立讲得很清楚，是研究日本美学概念的必备工具书。
intent.reception_good_en: The first systematic Chinese rendering of Onishi's three studies; Wang's preface clearly explains how 'aesthetics' was installed as an imported discipline in Japan — an essential reference.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 三论合卷后体量庞大，术语密度高；且大西的分析高度依赖德语美学术语，中译有时不得不造词，读者需要耐心。
intent.reception_bad_en: Collected in one volume it is bulky and terminologically dense; Onishi leans on German aesthetic vocabulary, so the Chinese sometimes coins terms and demands patience.
intent.syn_zh: 当工具书用：先读译本序与每论结论，再按需查章节。若只读一论，建议从「物哀」入手，它对特辑的情绪基调最直接。
intent.syn_en: Use it as a reference: read the preface and each study's conclusion, then consult chapters as needed. If only one, start with aware — it speaks most directly to the Special's emotional key.

plot_acts.zh: 节选出自 Michele Marra 编《A History of Modern Japanese Aesthetics》（2001），选段把大西的物哀论放进英语学界的美学叙事，而不是单独成书。
plot_acts.en: The excerpt comes from Michele Marra's anthology A History of Modern Japanese Aesthetics (2001), where Onishi's account of aware sits inside an English-language narrative of Japanese aesthetics rather than standing alone.

plot_acts.zh: 英译保留 mono no aware 的音译，再以 impermanence、sentiment 等词作解释。术语被保留，语义却被重新编排，这正是读节选最该留意的地方。
plot_acts.en: The translation keeps mono no aware in romanised form and explains it through words such as impermanence and sentiment. The term survives, but its semantics are rearranged, which is exactly what an excerpt asks the reader to notice.

plot_acts.zh: 节选不能替代三论全本，也不足以还原大西的方法。本页把它当作「翻译个案」来读，而不是当作大西原论。
plot_acts.en: The excerpt cannot replace the full trilogy or restore Onishi's method. This page reads it as a case in translation, not as Onishi's own argument.

plot_flow.zh: Marra 编本把日本美学写成现代学科史
plot_flow.en: Marra's anthology writes Japanese aesthetics as a modern discipline

plot_flow.zh: 大西物哀论被选入，成为其中一章的英译材料
plot_flow.en: Onishi's study of aware is selected as English source material for one chapter

plot_flow.zh: 术语音译保留，解释词替换原义，形成读解偏移
plot_flow.en: The term is transliterated while explanatory words replace its sense, producing a shift

craft.zh: 编本形态：节选加编者导言，读者须分清哪句是大西、哪句是编者。
craft.en: Edited-volume form: excerpt plus editor's introduction — distinguish Onishi's sentences from the editor's.

craft.zh: 术语翻译的现场：aware 被译与不译之间，正是概念跨语的难点。
craft.en: At the scene of translation: whether to render aware or leave it untranslated is the cross-linguistic crux.

motifs.evid_zh: 英语转述最常抓住的一极，但大西的重心在「感应」而非「悲观」。
motifs.evid_en: The pole English restatements grasp most; Onishi's centre is attunement, not pessimism.

motifs.evid_zh: 英译常有的偏移：把前道德的感应读成情绪。
motifs.evid_en: A frequent English drift: reading pre-moral attunement as emotion.

excerpts.trans_zh: 这段英译把「物哀」放进无常、感伤与前道德感应三个坐标里，与日语原意有细微偏移：aware 的「哀」被读成情绪，而原词更接近于对事物之「あはれ」的感应。读它主要读翻译的选择。
excerpts.trans_en: The English excerpt places mono no aware within impermanence, sentiment and pre-moral attunement, a slight shift from the Japanese. The aware in mono no aware is read as emotion, while the word is closer to being moved by things. One reads it for the translator's choices.

excerpts.source_en: On Mono no Aware (English excerpt): Paraphrase after the publisher's description and standard accounts; not a quotation.

deep_read.en: See how Marra's introduction frames 'Japanese aesthetics' as a whole; it explains the excerpt's choices.

deep_read.zh: 把这条英译通道与九鬼的 Nara 译本对比：一个完整翻译，一个节选，接受效果完全不同。
deep_read.en: Compare this channel with Nara's complete Kuki: full translation vs excerpt produce very different receptions.

books.why_zh: 「物哀」进入英文学术语汇的通道之一。本页不再虚构一个 2022 年单行英译本，而如实记录它目前的英译形态：收入编本的节选。
books.why_en: One channel by which aware entered English scholarly vocabulary. This page no longer invents a 2022 standalone translation but records the actual English form: an excerpt in an edited volume.

background.zh: 大西克礼的《物哀论》是三部曲的中篇，英文世界长期没有单行译本。可核实的通道是 Michele Marra 编 A History of Modern Japanese Aesthetics（University of Hawai'i Press, 2001）中对大西物哀论的节译与讨论；此外英语研究（如关于 Onishi 的 sabi 与 aware 的论文）多转引其日文原著。旧档案所记「约 2022 年英译单行本」查无书目依据，已改为本条并降为 ○。
background.en: Onishi's aware study is the middle panel of the trilogy, and the English world long lacked a standalone translation. The verifiable channel is the excerpt and discussion of Onishi's aware in Michele Marra (ed.), A History of Modern Japanese Aesthetics (University of Hawai'i Press, 2001); English scholarship otherwise cites the Japanese original. The old record's 'c.2022 standalone English translation' has no bibliographic basis and is replaced by this entry at ○.

narrative.zh: 作为节选，它不能替代原著，但能看出英语学界如何转述「物哀」：多半把它放在「无常」「感伤」「前道德感应」三个坐标里，与日语原意有细微偏移。读它主要是读「翻译的选择」，而不是读大西。
narrative.en: As an excerpt it cannot replace the original, but it shows how English scholarship restates aware: usually within impermanence, sentiment and pre-moral attunement — a slight shift from the Japanese. One reads it for the choices of translation, not for Onishi whole.

quotes.orig: 物哀＝见落花而心有所动，一种先于善恶的审美感应。
quotes.trans_zh: 物哀＝见落花而心有所动，一种先于善恶的审美感应。
quotes.trans_en: Mono no aware is the moved heart at falling petals — an aesthetic attunement prior to good and evil.
quotes.source: 范畴论旨概述（非逐字原文） · ◐

intent.reception_good_zh: 让英语读者知道「物哀」不是简单的「悲」，而是一套关于感应与无常的审美结构；编本的注释也提供了日文文献线索。
intent.reception_good_en: It shows English readers that aware is not mere sadness but a structure of attunement and impermanence; the volume's notes also give Japanese sources.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 节选必然割裂论证；且英语转述常把 aware 浪漫化为「日本式感伤」，失掉大西的概念史严格性。
intent.reception_bad_en: An excerpt inevitably fragments the argument, and English restatements often romanticise aware as Japanese sentimentality, losing Onishi's conceptual rigour.
intent.syn_zh: 把它当「接受史材料」而非「译本」：读英语如何误读，也是一种读法。真正的文本仍须回到《幽玄·物哀·寂》。
intent.syn_en: Treat it as reception history rather than a translation: reading how English misreads is itself a method. The real text remains the trilogy.

plot_acts.title_zh: 第一章 人性的茶杯
plot_acts.zh: 以茶为文明的和解剂：茶从药物变成饮品，再变成一种信仰。提出「茶道是对不完美的崇拜」。
plot_acts.en: Tea as a civiliser: from medicine to drink to faith. Here comes the claim that teaism is the worship of the imperfect.

plot_acts.title_zh: 第二—三章 茶的流派 / 道家与禅
plot_acts.title_en: II–III · Schools of Tea / Taoism and Zennism
plot_acts.zh: 梳理茶在中国三阶段的演变，并说明道家「虚」与禅宗「自性」如何成为茶道的哲学底座。
plot_acts.en: Tea's three stages in China, and how Taoist emptiness and Zen self-nature became teaism's philosophical base.

plot_acts.title_zh: 第四—五章 茶室 / 艺术鉴赏
plot_acts.zh: 茶室作为「空虚」的建筑：不对称、简陋、刻意留白。鉴赏不是判断，而是与作品互相进入。
plot_acts.en: The tea-room as architecture of emptiness: asymmetry, simplicity, deliberate void. Appreciation is not judgement but mutual entry with the work.

plot_acts.title_zh: 第六—七章 花 / 茶师
plot_acts.zh: 插花反对园艺式的修剪，茶师则以人格完成茶道。末章把美学收束为伦理。
plot_acts.en: Flower arrangement against garden pruning; the tea-master completes teaism through character. The close turns aesthetics into ethics.

craft.zh: 以器载道：茶杯、茶室、一枝花，都是通往宇宙论的入口。
craft.en: The vessel carries the doctrine: a cup, a room, a single flower are entrances to cosmology.

craft.zh: 英文散文的节奏：短句与长句交替，带十九世纪随笔的从容。
craft.en: The rhythm of the English prose: short and long sentences alternating with nineteenth-century ease.

craft.zh: 比较法：不断把东方与西方并置，让西方读者在自己的参照系里理解茶道。
craft.en: Comparison throughout: East and West side by side, so Western readers grasp teaism within their own frame.

motifs.evid_zh: 茶道的核心信仰：残缺不是缺陷，而是邀请。
motifs.evid_en: Teaism's core faith: the incomplete is not a defect but an invitation.

motifs.evid_zh: 茶室的留白与不对称，是道家「虚」的建筑化。
motifs.evid_en: The tea-room's void and asymmetry architecturally render Taoist emptiness.

motifs.evid_zh: 末章把美学收束为伦理：懂茶即懂如何做人。
motifs.evid_en: The close turns aesthetics into ethics: to know tea is to know how to be a person.

books.author: Okakura Kakuzō
books.publisher: G. P. Putnam's Sons, New York
books.meta_zh: 英文自述 · 七章
books.baseline_conf: ✓ 初版 / 公版全文 / 章节结构已核
books.baseline_conf_en: ✓ first edition, public-domain text, chapter structure verified
books.why_zh: 「日本美」向世界自我陈述的原点文本，公版可逐字引用。它把茶室写成一套宇宙论，也把「不完美」写成了信仰。
books.why_en: The origin text of Japan's aesthetic self-statement to the world, public domain and quotable verbatim. It turns the tea-room into a cosmology and imperfection into a faith.

background.zh: 冈仓天心（1863—1913）以英文写作，1906 年在纽约出版本书，面向西方读者解释茶道。全书七章：人性的茶杯、茶的流派、道家与禅、茶室、艺术鉴赏、花、茶师。其著名论断是「茶道是对不完美的崇拜」：在污浊的日常里崇拜美，在残缺中看见完成。它既是美学导论，也是近代日本向西方争取文化主体性的一次外交式写作。
background.en: Okakura Kakuzō (1863–1913) wrote in English; the book appeared in New York in 1906 to explain teaism to Western readers. Its seven chapters run: The Cup of Humanity, The Schools of Tea, Taoism and Zennism, The Tea-Room, Art Appreciation, Flowers, The Tea-Masters. Its famous claim is that teaism is the adoration of the imperfect: beauty among sordid facts, completion in the incomplete. It is at once an introduction to aesthetics and a diplomatic bid for cultural subjecthood.

narrative.zh: 七章从一只茶杯写到整个东方宇宙观：先讲茶如何从中国传入日本，再讲道家与禅如何给茶道提供哲学，最后落到茶室、插花与茶师的人格。论证方式是「以小见大」——每一章都从一个器物或仪式出发，推向一种人生态度。
narrative.en: Seven chapters move from a teacup to an Eastern cosmology: how tea came from China to Japan, how Taoism and Zen supplied its philosophy, then the tea-room, flower arrangement and the tea-master's character. The method is synecdoche — each chapter starts from an object or rite and opens onto an attitude to life.

intent.reception_good_zh: 二十世纪最成功的日本文化外宣文本之一：用西方读者能懂的古典学养与英文散文，把茶道讲成一种普遍的人生哲学。至今仍是英语世界进入日本美学的第一本书。
intent.reception_good_en: One of the most successful cultural exports of the twentieth century: classical learning and English prose legible to Western readers turn teaism into a universal philosophy of life. It remains the first book through which the English world enters Japanese aesthetics.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 批评在于「太美」：为了向西方陈述，冈仓把茶道理想化、去历史化，略去茶道的政治与阶级背景；「东方」在他笔下也被写成一个整体。
intent.reception_bad_en: The criticism is that it is too beautiful: to address the West, Okakura idealises and de-historicises teaism, omitting its politics and class base, and writes 'the East' as a whole.
intent.syn_zh: 读它要同时读两层：一层是茶的真实历史，一层是 1906 年一个日本知识分子如何对西方说话。前者可补《日本侘寂》，后者可接《武士道》。
intent.syn_en: Read two layers at once: the actual history of tea, and how a Japanese intellectual addressed the West in 1906. The first leads to wabi-sabi, the second to Bushido.

plot_acts.title_zh: 第一—三章 体系、源流、义
plot_acts.zh: 先定义武士道为「武士须遵守的道德准则」，再追溯佛教、神道与儒家三源，最后立「义」为德目之首。
plot_acts.en: Defines bushido as the code knights were required to observe, traces Buddhist, Shinto and Confucian sources, and sets rectitude first among virtues.

plot_acts.title_zh: 第四—九章 勇、仁、礼、信、忠、名誉
plot_acts.title_en: IV–IX · Courage, benevolence, courtesy, truth, loyalty, honour
plot_acts.zh: 德目逐一展开：勇须有「仁」来节制，礼是「对他人的体贴」，忠与名誉则构成社会纽带。
plot_acts.en: The virtues unfold: courage must be tempered by benevolence, courtesy is consideration for others, loyalty and honour form the social bond.

plot_acts.title_zh: 第十—十四章 教育、克己、切腹、刀、女性
plot_acts.title_en: X–XIV · Training, self-control, seppuku, the sword, women
plot_acts.zh: 制度层面：武士如何被养成，切腹如何被赋予伦理意义，刀如何成为「武士之魂」，女性如何被教育。
plot_acts.en: Institutions: how samurai were formed, how seppuku was given ethical meaning, how the sword became the samurai's soul, how women were educated.

plot_acts.title_zh: 第十五—十七章 影响、存续、未来
plot_acts.zh: 末三章转向现代：武士道是否仍活在日本人的行为里？新渡户的回答是「活着的，但需要转化」。
plot_acts.en: The last three turn modern: does bushido still live in Japanese conduct? Nitobe's answer is yes, but it must be transformed.

craft.zh: 比较论证：几乎每个德目都配一个欧洲对应物，降低西方读者的理解成本。
craft.en: Comparative argument: nearly every virtue gets a European analogue, lowering the cost for Western readers.

craft.zh: 自辩的语气：不是中立描述，而是「请你们不要误解我们」的辩护。
craft.en: A defensive tone: not neutral description but a plea not to misread us.

craft.zh: 以人物轶事证德：用具体故事代替抽象定义。
craft.en: Virtue proved by anecdote: concrete stories instead of abstract definitions.

motifs.evid_zh: 新渡户列为诸德之首：无义之勇只是蛮力。
motifs.evid_en: First of the virtues: courage without rectitude is mere force.

motifs.evid_zh: 武士行为的最高裁判，也是切腹的逻辑起点。
motifs.evid_en: The highest court of samurai conduct and the logic behind seppuku.

motifs.evid_zh: 武士道不是法典，而是习惯与教养的沉淀。
motifs.evid_en: Bushido is not a code but sedimented habit and cultivation.

excerpts.orig: Bushido, then, is the code of moral principles which the knights were required or instructed to observe.
excerpts.trans_zh: 武士道，便是那些骑士被要求或被教导去遵守的道德准则。
excerpts.trans_en: Bushido, then, is the code of moral principles which the knights were required or instructed to observe.
excerpts.note_zh: 全书定义句：注意「required or instructed」——它既是强制也是教化。
excerpts.note_en: The defining sentence: note 'required or instructed' — both compulsion and cultivation.

deep_read.zh: 读每一德目时问：这是历史事实，还是新渡户为了向西方解释而做的整理？
deep_read.en: Of each virtue ask: is this history, or Nitobe's arrangement for Western explanation?

deep_read.zh: 把「切腹」一章与《菊与刀》的「耻感」章对读，看两种文化解释如何互相加固。
deep_read.en: Read the seppuku chapter against Benedict's shame chapter and see how two cultural explanations reinforce each other.

deep_read.zh: 注意书中女性一章：它暴露了武士道伦理的性别结构，也是全书最容易被跳过的一章。
deep_read.en: Note the chapter on women: it exposes the gender structure of bushido and is the chapter most easily skipped.

related.note_en: Two self-portraits for the West, one of virtue, one of beauty.

books.why_zh: 把封建伦理讲成世界能懂的公民道德；它既是日本的自辩，也是后来《菊与刀》一路「日本论」的靶子。
books.why_en: It renders feudal virtue as a civic ethics the world could grasp — at once Japan's self-defence and the target of later Japan-ologies from Benedict onward.

background.zh: 新渡户稻造（1862—1933）以英文写成此书，1900 年出版，1905 年由纽约 Putnam 推出修订版后在英语世界广泛流传。全书十七章，从「作为伦理体系的武士道」讲到义、勇、仁、礼、信、忠、名誉，再到切腹、刀、女性教育，最后问「武士道还活着吗」。它是在基督教西方面前为日本伦理辩护的著作，也因此把「武士道」本质化为一个统一体系。
background.en: Nitobe Inazō (1862–1933) wrote in English; the book appeared in 1900 and, after a revised Putnam edition of 1905, circulated widely. Its seventeen chapters run from Bushido as an ethical system through rectitude, courage, benevolence, courtesy, veracity, loyalty and honour to seppuku, the sword and women's education, closing with 'Is Bushido still alive?'. Written to defend Japanese ethics before a Christian West, it also essentialised bushido into a single system.

narrative.zh: 十七章像一部德目辞典，但有一条暗线：武士道不是成文法典，而是「活的伦理」——由武士阶层的习惯、荣誉感与教养沉淀而成。新渡户不断用欧洲的骑士、基督教与哲学作比，让西方读者在熟悉的坐标里接受日本。
narrative.en: The seventeen chapters read like a dictionary of virtues, but a thread runs through: bushido is not a written code but a living ethic sedimented from samurai habit, honour and cultivation. Nitobe constantly compares with European chivalry, Christianity and philosophy so Western readers can receive Japan in familiar coordinates.

quotes.orig: Bushido, then, is the code of moral principles which the knights were required or instructed to observe.
quotes.trans_zh: 武士道，便是那些骑士被要求或被教导去遵守的道德准则。
quotes.trans_en: Bushido, then, is the code of moral principles which the knights were required or instructed to observe.

quotes.source_en: Ch. I, What is Bushido · public-domain text ✓ (Gutenberg #12096)

intent.reception_good_zh: 英语世界理解日本伦理的入门书，也是「武士道」一词进入西方语言的主要通道；文笔典雅，引用欧洲经典自如。
intent.reception_good_en: The English world's primer on Japanese ethics and the main channel by which 'bushido' entered Western languages; elegant, freely citing European classics.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 把武士道写成整齐的德目体系，掩盖了它历史上的暴力与阶级性；后来的民族主义也乐于引用此书，使它背上「军国主义辩护」的嫌疑。
intent.reception_bad_en: Writing bushido as a tidy system of virtues obscures its historical violence and class character; later nationalism gladly cited the book, saddling it with a suspicion of militarist apology.
intent.syn_zh: 与《菊与刀》对读：新渡户从内部说「我们如此」，本尼迪克特从外部说「他们如此」。两本合读，才看得见「日本论」的两种视线。
intent.syn_en: Read with Benedict: Nitobe says from inside 'this is how we are', Benedict from outside 'this is how they are'. Together they show the two gazes of Japan-ology.

plot_acts.zh: 最不雅的场所反而最适合谈美：幽暗、木香、雨声，构成一个与自然相通的私密空间。
plot_acts.en: The least elegant place is best for beauty: gloom, wood, rain — a private room continuous with nature.

plot_acts.zh: 漆器的美依赖昏暗：在电灯下它只剩黑，在烛光里它才有深度。谷崎由此展开对「照明进步」的批判。
plot_acts.en: Lacquer depends on dimness: under electric light it is merely black, in candlelight it has depth. From this he attacks the 'progress' of lighting.

plot_acts.zh: 把阴翳从器物推到空间与表演：能乐的暗、和室的深邃、汤碗的黑红，都是同一美学。
plot_acts.en: Shadow extends from objects to space and performance: Noh's darkness, the depth of the washitsu, the black-red of soup bowls — one aesthetics.

plot_acts.zh: 末段回到命题：美不是属性，而是物与物之间明暗的波纹。
plot_acts.en: The close returns to the thesis: beauty is not a property but the ripple of light and dark between things.

craft.zh: 从低处进入：以厕所、便器、食物等不雅对象起笔，反而更有说服力。
craft.en: Entering low: toilets, chamber pots and food make the argument more persuasive, not less.

craft.zh: 感官的具体性：不说「幽暗很美」，而说漆器在烛光下如何。
craft.en: Sensory concreteness: not 'gloom is beautiful' but what lacquer does in candlelight.

craft.zh: 文明比较：西方/日本不是本质对立，而是两种处理光的技术选择。
craft.en: Civilisational comparison: West and Japan are not essences but two technical choices about light.

motifs.evid_zh: 不是黑暗本身，而是明暗之间的过渡地带。
motifs.evid_en: Not darkness itself but the zone of transition between light and dark.

motifs.evid_zh: 谷崎的核心物证：它的美只在昏暗中成立。
motifs.evid_en: Tanizaki's key exhibit: its beauty exists only in dimness.

motifs.evid_zh: 被批判的「进步」：电灯不是中性工具，而是文明选择。
motifs.evid_en: The 'progress' under critique: electric light is not neutral but a civilisational choice.

excerpts.trans_zh: 谷崎从最不雅的场所写起，一路升到建筑与戏剧，再落回器物。他的论证是倒着走的：先让你承认一个不好意思承认的偏好，再指出这偏好背后是一整套文明对光与暗的分配。
excerpts.trans_en: Tanizaki begins with the least presentable room, rises to architecture and drama, and returns to objects. His argument runs backwards: first admit a preference you would rather not admit, then see that behind it lies a whole civilisation's division of light and dark.
excerpts.source: 《阴翳礼赞》论旨概述 · 据出版说明与通行引述（非逐字）
excerpts.source_en: 陰翳礼讃: Paraphrase after the publisher's description and standard accounts; not a quotation.

deep_read.zh: 读时关掉顶灯，只留一盏台灯，再读漆器与烛光一段——这是谷崎要求的阅读条件。
deep_read.en: Read the lacquer-and-candle passage with the overhead light off and a single lamp on — the condition Tanizaki asks for.

deep_read.zh: 标出所有「西洋」出现的地方，看谷崎如何把西方写成单一整体；这是全书最大的简化。
deep_read.en: Mark every appearance of 'the West' and see how Tanizaki writes it as one whole — the book's greatest simplification.

deep_read.zh: 与《摩灭之赋》对读同一件器物（如老碗）：一个看它如何反光，一个看它如何被磨薄。
deep_read.en: Read the same object (an old bowl) in Erosion: one watches how it reflects, the other how it is worn thin.

books.publines_en: serialised 1933–34 · many Chinese eds. · EN Harper 1977 / Starr 2017

books.baseline_conf: ✓ 年代 / 英译已核；中译版目 ◐
books.baseline_conf_en: ✓ dates and English translations; Chinese editions ◐
books.why_zh: 特辑《摩灭》《侘寂》两册的美学母源：谷崎第一次把「暗」写成日本美的条件，而不是照明的失败。
books.why_en: The mother-source of the Special's Erosion and Wabi-Sabi volumes: Tanizaki first writes darkness as a condition of Japanese beauty rather than a failure of lighting.

background.zh: 《陰翳礼讃》1933—1934 年连载，后收入《文章読本》一系随笔。谷崎从厕所、漆器、烛光、能乐面具写到餐具与建筑，主张美不在对象本身，而在对象所处的阴翳之中。他并非单纯怀旧，而是指出：西方以照明消灭阴影，日本则以阴影保存物件的深度。中译有陈德文等多种，英译以 Thomas J. Harper（1977）与 Gregory Starr（2017）较为通行。
background.en: In Praise of Shadows was serialised in 1933–34. From toilets, lacquerware, candlelight and Noh masks to tableware and architecture, Tanizaki argues that beauty lies not in the object but in the shadow it inhabits. This is not mere nostalgia: the West abolishes shadow with lighting, Japan preserves depth through it. Chinese versions include Chen Dewen's; the usual English ones are Thomas J. Harper (1977) and Gregory Starr (2017).

narrative.zh: 文章从最不雅的场所（厕所）写起，一路升到建筑与戏剧，最后落回日常器物。谷崎的策略是「从低处进入」：先让你承认一个不好意思承认的偏好，再告诉你这偏好背后是一整套文明选择。
narrative.en: It begins in the least elegant place — the toilet — rises through architecture and theatre, and returns to everyday objects. Tanizaki's strategy is to enter low: first make you admit a preference you are ashamed of, then show that behind it lies a whole civilisational choice.

quotes.orig: 美不在对象本身，而在对象所处的阴翳之中。
quotes.trans_zh: 美不在对象本身，而在对象所处的阴翳之中。
quotes.trans_en: Beauty lies not in the object but in the shadow it dwells in.
quotes.source: 谷崎论旨概述（非逐字原文） · ◐ 译文随版本
quotes.source_en: summary of Tanizaki's thesis (not verbatim) · ◐ wording per edition

intent.reception_good_zh: 二十世纪日本美学最有影响力的单篇随笔；它把「阴翳」从一个趣味词提升为文明比较的范畴，直接启发了后来的侘寂与摩灭写作。
intent.reception_good_en: The most influential single essay in twentieth-century Japanese aesthetics; it lifts 'shadow' from a term of taste to a category of civilisational comparison and directly enables later writing on wabi-sabi and erosion.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 容易被读成「怀旧散文」或「反现代化」；谷崎对女性与感官的描写也常被后来的读者批评为男性凝视。
intent.reception_bad_en: Easily read as nostalgic prose or anti-modernism; Tanizaki's descriptions of women and the senses are also criticised as a male gaze.
intent.syn_zh: 读它不要停在「日本很美」，要抓住「美在关系」这一命题，再用它去看《摩灭之赋》如何把关系换成时间。
intent.syn_en: Do not stop at 'Japan is beautiful'; grasp the proposition that beauty is relational, then see how Erosion swaps relation for time.

plot_acts.zh: 开篇「つれづれなるままに」自述写作状态：无事可做，随手记下心中流过的琐事。无常由此不是教义，而是写作的起因。
plot_acts.en: The opening declares the condition of writing: idle, jotting whatever passes through the mind. Impermanence is thus not doctrine but the cause of writing.

plot_acts.zh: 中段多写人：如何交友、如何说话、如何避免可笑。兼好的伦理不是戒律，而是「得体」——知道什么场合说什么话。
plot_acts.en: The middle is full of people: how to make friends, how to speak, how to avoid absurdity. Kenkō's ethics is not commandment but tact — knowing what to say where.

plot_acts.zh: 末段转向和歌、音乐、花木与季节：美在将逝未逝之际最动人，这是「物哀」的散文版。
plot_acts.en: The close turns to waka, music, plants and seasons: beauty moves most at the edge of vanishing — the prose version of aware.

craft.zh: 段与段的留白：不解释、不连接，让读者自己补上因果关系。
craft.en: White space between sections: no explanation, no connective, the reader supplies causation.

craft.zh: 以小事见大：一段写一个人怎么拿筷子，就能看出他的教养与命运。
craft.en: The great in the small: how a person holds chopsticks reveals upbringing and fate.

craft.zh: 冷静的幽默：兼好从不嘲讽，只是把人的可笑如实摆出来。
craft.en: Cool humour: Kenkō never mocks, only sets human absurdity down as it is.

motifs.evid_zh: 不是悲观，而是观察的起点：一切都在变，故一切值得看。
motifs.evid_en: Not pessimism but the starting point of observation: all things change, so all things are worth watching.

motifs.evid_zh: 无事可做的状态，反而是写作与观看的条件。
motifs.evid_en: Having nothing to do becomes the condition of writing and watching.

motifs.evid_zh: 兼好的伦理核心：知道场合与分寸。
motifs.evid_en: Kenkō's ethical core: knowing occasion and measure.

excerpts.orig: つれづれなるままに、日暮らし、硯にむかひて、心にうつりゆくよしなし事を、そこはかとなく書きつくれば、あやしうこそものぐるほしけれ。
excerpts.trans_zh: 百无聊赖之中，终日面对砚台，把心中流过的种种琐事随手写下来，竟也觉得莫名地心绪纷乱。
excerpts.trans_en: In sheer idleness, day after day at the inkstone, I set down whatever trifles drift through my mind — and find myself oddly unsettled.
excerpts.note_zh: 序段全文，公版；中译为大意，非王以铸译文。
excerpts.note_en: The full preface, public domain; the Chinese is a paraphrase, not Wang Yizhu's text.

deep_read.zh: 每天只读三段，读完写一句「这一段在看我什么」；243 段读完，等于做了一次自我观察。
deep_read.en: Read three sections a day and write one line on what each sees in you; after 243 you will have performed a self-observation.

deep_read.zh: 把讲「死」的段落与讲「花」的段落并置，看兼好如何用同一个语气谈两者。
deep_read.en: Set the sections on death beside those on flowers and see how Kenkō uses one tone for both.

deep_read.zh: 与《风姿花传》对读：一个讲艺人如何不朽，一个讲一切皆朽，同一时代的两副面孔。
deep_read.en: Read with Fūshikaden: one asks how an artist endures, one that all things pass — two faces of one era.

books.why_zh: 日本随笔（zuihitsu）的源头之一，也是特辑三本文学手记的上溯母脉：无体系、有节律，把无常写成日常的观察方法。
books.why_en: One of the sources of Japanese zuihitsu and the upstream vein of the Special's three notebooks: no system, but a rhythm that turns impermanence into a method of daily observation.

background.zh: 《徒然草》约成书于 14 世纪上半叶（通行说法约 1330 年前后），作者兼好法师（吉田兼好，1283?—1350?）是歌人、随笔家，曾仕于朝廷后出家。全书 243 段，长短不一：杂感、评论、小故事、人物轶事并存。它与此前的《枕草子》、同时代的《方丈记》并称日本三大随笔。中译由王以铸完成，商务印书馆 2022 年出版，保留 243 段体例。
background.en: Essays in Idleness was composed in the first half of the fourteenth century (conventionally around 1330). Its author, Yoshida Kenkō (1283?–1350?), was a poet and essayist who served at court before taking vows. Its 243 sections vary in length — impressions, judgements, anecdotes, character sketches — and it stands with The Pillow Book and Hōjōki as one of Japan's three great zuihitsu. Wang Yizhu's Chinese version (Commercial Press, 2022) keeps the 243 sections.

narrative.zh: 没有论证，也没有统一主题，靠「段」与「段」之间的呼吸形成整体。兼好的基本姿态是「看」：看人如何执着，看物如何衰败，看自己如何同样可笑。无常不是结论，而是他观察一切的起点。
narrative.en: There is no argument and no single theme; the whole emerges from the breathing between sections. Kenkō's stance is watching: how people cling, how things decay, how he is equally absurd. Impermanence is not a conclusion but the point from which he observes everything.

quotes.orig: つれづれなるままに、日暮らし、硯にむかひて、心にうつりゆくよしなし事を、そこはかとなく書きつくれば、あやしうこそものぐるほしけれ。
quotes.trans_zh: 百无聊赖之中，终日面对砚台，把心中流过的种种琐事随手写下来，竟也觉得莫名地心绪纷乱。
quotes.trans_en: In sheer idleness, day after day at the inkstone, I set down whatever trifles drift through my mind — and find myself oddly unsettled.
quotes.source: 《徒然草》序段 · 公版原文 ✓（中译为大意）
quotes.source_en: Tsurezuregusa, preface · public-domain original ✓ (Chinese is a paraphrase)

intent.reception_good_zh: 日本随笔的典范，也是理解「无常」最不教条的一本书；王以铸的译本以典雅白话保留文言语感，243 段体例完整。
intent.reception_good_en: The model of Japanese zuihitsu and the least doctrinal book about impermanence; Wang Yizhu's elegant vernacular keeps the classical feel and the full 243 sections.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 对现代读者，前一百段的人物轶事与官职典故门槛较高；且「无常」被流行文化简化为「丧」，与原书的冷静观察相去甚远。
intent.reception_bad_en: For modern readers the early anecdotes and court titles are demanding, and popular culture flattens impermanence into gloom, far from the book's cool observation.
intent.syn_zh: 当作「方法书」读：学兼好如何看人、看物、看自己。它与《草枕》的「非人情」是同一种姿态的两种写法。
intent.syn_en: Read it as a method book: learn how Kenkō watches people, things and himself. It and Kusamakura's 'non-human feeling' are two versions of one stance.

plot_acts.zh: 按年龄分阶段：七岁至十二三岁以自然之艺为主，此后逐年调整，直到老年仍有「老木之花」。
plot_acts.en: Stages by age: natural art from seven to twelve or thirteen, adjusted year by year, until old age still has its 'flower of the old tree'.

plot_acts.zh: 谈如何向前辈学艺、如何辨别「物真似」与「花」：模仿只是入口，能变才是艺。
plot_acts.en: How to learn from elders and how to distinguish imitation from flower: mimicry is only the entrance; transformation is the art.

plot_acts.title_en: Ritual, secrets, cultivation of the flower
plot_acts.zh: 进入秘传层：能乐的仪式性、艺的深层结构，以及如何在不同「时」里保持花。
plot_acts.en: The secret layer: Noh's ritual dimension, the deep structure of the art, and how to keep the flower across changing times.

craft.zh: 以年龄为结构：把艺术生命写成一条可训练的曲线。
craft.en: Age as structure: an artistic life written as a trainable curve.

craft.zh: 秘传的修辞：越核心的内容越用暗示，迫使弟子在实践里领会。
craft.en: The rhetoric of secrecy: the more central the content, the more it hints, forcing the pupil to learn in practice.

craft.zh: 观众中心：所有判断最后都落在「观众此刻是否被惊动」。
craft.en: Audience-centred: every judgement lands on whether the audience is moved now.

motifs.evid_zh: 观众意料之外的惊艳，是艺的瞬间真理。
motifs.evid_en: The shock of the unexpected in the audience — the art's momentary truth.

motifs.evid_zh: 美的标准随时而变，故艺人须懂「时」而不只是「艺」。
motifs.evid_en: Standards of beauty shift with the age, so the artist must know time, not only craft.

motifs.evid_zh: 模仿是入口而非终点：能变才是艺。
motifs.evid_en: Imitation is entrance, not end: transformation is the art.

excerpts.trans_zh: 《风姿花传》是给艺人的训练手册，不是美学论文：从七岁的修习排到老年，从选曲排到场合。理论藏在训练法里。世阿弥反复谈的其实是观众此刻心里被惊动的那一下，也就是「花」。
excerpts.trans_en: Fushikaden is a training manual for performers, not an aesthetic treatise: practice from age seven to old age, repertory by occasion. Its theory lives inside the training. What Zeami keeps discussing is the moment a flower opens in the audience's mind.
excerpts.source: 《风姿花传》论旨概述 · 据出版说明与通行引述（非逐字）
excerpts.source_en: 風姿花伝: Paraphrase after the publisher's description and standard accounts; not a quotation.

deep_read.zh: 先读「年来稽古」，把它当成一份人生课程表；再读后面诸篇，理论才有落点。
deep_read.en: Read the age-based training first as a life curriculum; the later theory then has a place to land.

deep_read.zh: 把「花」与《茶之书》的「不完美」对读：一个讲瞬间惊艳，一个讲残缺之美，都是反完成的美学。
deep_read.en: Read 'flower' against The Book of Tea's imperfection: one is momentary shock, one incomplete beauty — both anti-completion aesthetics.

deep_read.zh: 查一下「秘すれば花」的出处争议，练习把「传诵句」与「原文」分开。
deep_read.en: Look up the disputed source of 'what is hidden is the flower' and practise separating received sayings from text.

books.why_zh: 「幽玄」范畴最早的艺道文本，也是大西幽玄研究的上游：美不是完成品，而是观众心里被惊动的那一下。
books.why_en: The earliest craft-text of yūgen and the upstream of Onishi's study: beauty is not a finished object but the shock in the audience's heart.

background.zh: 世阿弥元清（1363?—1443?）是室町前期的能乐艺人、理论家。《风姿花传》约成书于 1400 年前后，原为传予子婿的秘传，今存诸本，通行结构为序与七篇（年来稽古、物学、问答、神仪、奥义、花修、奥义）。核心概念是「花」：观众意料之外的那一下惊艳；以及「时」：美的标准随时代变化。「秘すれば花」一类名句常被引用，但确切文本归属学界有异，本页不取逐字。
background.en: Zeami Motokiyo (1363?–1443?) was a Muromachi Noh actor and theorist. Fūshikaden was completed around 1400 as a secret transmission to his son-in-law; the received structure is a preface and seven fascicles. Its core concepts are hana — the shock of the unexpected in the audience — and toki, the way standards of beauty shift with the age. The famous line 'what is hidden is the flower' is widely quoted, though its exact textual home is debated; no verbatim quotation is given here.

narrative.zh: 它不是美学论文，而是给艺人的训练手册：如何从七岁到老年安排修习，如何在不同场合选曲，如何让「花」在观众心里开放。理论藏在训练法里——世阿弥谈的每一件事最后都回到「观众此刻的感受」。
narrative.en: It is not an aesthetic treatise but a training manual: how to schedule practice from age seven to old age, how to choose pieces for an occasion, how to make the flower open in the audience. Theory hides inside method — everything returns to the audience's present feeling.

quotes.orig: 花即是秘，说破即谢。
quotes.trans_zh: 花即是秘，说破即谢。
quotes.trans_en: The flower is the secret; to speak it out is to wither it.
quotes.source: 传诵句 · ◐ 文本归属有异（或近《花镜》）
quotes.source_en: a received saying · ◐ textual home debated (perhaps Hana-Kagami)

intent.reception_good_zh: 日本艺道论的源头文本，影响能乐、茶道、俳谐乃至现代表演理论；「花」与「时」两个概念至今被反复引用。
intent.reception_good_en: The source text of Japanese craft theory, shaping Noh, tea, haikai and modern performance theory; 'flower' and 'time' are still cited.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 秘传体例使文本难以通读，且不同传本差异大；现代读者容易把「花」浪漫化，忽略它原本是训练与观众管理的技术概念。
intent.reception_bad_en: The secret-transmission form makes it hard to read, and the recensions differ widely; modern readers romanticise 'flower' and forget it was a technical concept of training and audience management.
intent.syn_zh: 把它当「训练手册」而非「美学宣言」：先看世阿弥如何安排一个人的一生，再理解「花」为何必须与「时」一起谈。
intent.syn_en: Read it as a training manual, not an aesthetic manifesto: first see how Zeami schedules a life, then why flower must be discussed with time.

craft.zh: 以「志」体写外国：借中国正史的权威形式，安放一个全新的对象。
craft.en: The gazetteer form applied abroad: the authority of the dynastic history houses a wholly new object.

craft.zh: 诗史互证：《日本杂事诗》记见闻，《日本国志》立体例，一感一质。
craft.en: Poetry and history corroborate each other: the verse records impressions, the gazetteer fixes structure.

craft.zh: 「外史氏曰」：叙述之后另起议论，把材料转成判断。
craft.en: The 'Outer Historian says': commentary after description, turning material into judgement.

motifs.evid_zh: 作者自设的评语人格，让志书不只是资料，也是策论。
motifs.evid_en: The author's invented commentator, making the gazetteer an argument as well as a record.

motifs.evid_zh: 写日本的最终用途，是为中国的自强提供可操作的参照。
motifs.evid_en: The ultimate use of writing Japan is to give China's self-strengthening an operable reference.

motifs.evid_zh: 十年成书、五十余万言，本身就是一种认识论的姿态。
motifs.evid_en: A decade of work and half a million characters are themselves an epistemological stance.

excerpts.trans_zh: 黄遵宪不按王朝更替纵述，而以制度门类横切：行政、财政、军制、法制、学术、风俗各成一志。体例本身就是判断。日本值得被当作一个完整国家来解剖，而不只是「蕞尔岛夷」。
excerpts.trans_en: Huang Zunxian does not narrate dynasties in sequence but cuts across institutions: administration, finance, military, law, learning and custom each form a treatise. The form is itself a judgement. Japan deserves dissection as a whole country, not dismissal as a small island neighbour.
excerpts.source: 《日本国志》论旨概述 · 据出版说明与通行引述（非逐字）
excerpts.source_en: 日本國志: Paraphrase after the publisher's description and standard accounts; not a quotation.

deep_read.zh: 先读地理、职官、食货三志，看黄遵宪如何把「日本」拆成可比较的模块；再读各志末的「外史氏曰」，看判断如何落下。
deep_read.en: Start with geography, offices and revenue to see Japan broken into comparable modules; then read the Outer Historian's closing notes to see judgement land.

deep_read.zh: 与《日本论》对读：黄遵宪写「是什么」，戴季陶写「会怎样」，前者是志，后者是策。
deep_read.en: Read with Dai Jitao: Huang writes what Japan is, Dai what it will do; one is gazetteer, the other policy.

deep_read.zh: 注意书中保留的汉文概念如何被用来翻译明治新制，这是「概念旅行」最早的一批样本。
deep_read.en: Watch how classical Chinese terms are stretched to translate Meiji institutions: some of the earliest samples of travelling concepts.

books.why_zh: 近代中国「知日」的原点，也是《分身》所追溯那条镜链的第一环。它把日本从一个模糊的邻邦，第一次写成了可查、可引、可作变法之资的对象。
books.why_en: The origin of modern China's knowing of Japan and the first link in the mirror-chain Avatar traces. It turned Japan from a vague neighbour into an object that could be consulted, cited and used for reform.

background.zh: 黄遵宪（1848—1905）1877 年随首任驻日公使何如璋赴日，任使馆参赞，遍访日本朝野；1882 年调任驻旧金山总领事，1885 年回国后闭门续写，1887 年成书，共四十卷、十二志、五十余万言，1895 年始刊行。十二志为国统、邻交、天文、地理、职官、食货、兵、刑法、学术、礼俗、物产、工艺，以中国正史的「志」体写一个外国的当代史，每志之后以「外史氏曰」发议论。它与作者早年的《日本杂事诗》互为表里：诗记见闻，志立体例。
background.en: Huang Zunxian (1848-1905) went to Japan in 1877 with the first minister He Ruzhang as legation counsellor and travelled widely; posted to San Francisco in 1882, he returned in 1885 and finished the book in 1887: forty juan, twelve treatises, over half a million characters, first printed in 1895. The treatises cover dynastic line, foreign relations, astronomy, geography, offices, revenue, arms, law, learning, custom, produce and craft, using the dynastic-gazetteer form to write a foreign country's contemporary history, each closing with commentary voiced by the 'Outer Historian'. It pairs with his earlier Japan Miscellany in Verse: the poems record what he saw, the treatises fix the form.
background.conf: ✓ 生平与体例；分志归并为导读性重构 ◐
background.conf_en: ✓ life and structure; the grouping below is a reading reconstruction ◐

narrative.zh: 全书是「横切」而非「纵述」：不以王朝更替为序，而以制度门类分卷，让读者一次看见明治日本的行政、财政、军制、法制、学术与风俗。这种写法本身即是一次判断，日本值得被当作一个完整国家来解剖，而不只是「蕞尔岛夷」。
narrative.en: The book cuts across rather than narrates: not dynastic succession but institutional compartments, so that Meiji Japan's administration, finance, army, law, learning and manners come into view at once. The form is itself a judgement: Japan deserves dissection as a whole country, not dismissal as a small island neighbour.

quotes.orig: 把「知日」第一次写成一部可查、可引的国志。
quotes.trans_zh: 把「知日」第一次写成一部可查、可引的国志。
quotes.trans_en: For the first time, knowing Japan becomes a consultable, citable national record.
quotes.source: 全书体例概述（非逐字原文） · ◐ 措辞待对点校本
quotes.source_en: summary of the book's design (not a verbatim line) · ◐ wording to check against the collated edition

intent.reception_good_zh: 中国第一部系统研究日本的著作，开创「知日—用日」的传统。志书体例使日本成为可比较、可引用的对象，直接影响戊戌前后的变法论述，也为此后所有中国人写日本提供了最初的格式。
intent.reception_good_en: The first systematic Chinese study of Japan, opening the know-and-use tradition. Its gazetteer form made Japan comparable and citable, shaped reform writing around 1898, and gave every later Chinese account of Japan its first format.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 以中国正史的框架套日本，制度分类未必贴合明治实况；「外史氏曰」的经世判断有时压倒材料本身。晚清士人读它，往往读出自己想读的变法。
intent.reception_bad_en: A Chinese dynastic frame imposed on Japan, its institutional categories not always fitting Meiji reality; the Outer Historian's statecraft sometimes overwhelms the record. Late-Qing readers tended to find the reform they wanted.
intent.syn_zh: 当「方法样本」读：看一个中国官员如何把陌生国家拆成可写、可比的模块。再与《日本论》对读，看记录如何变成判断。
intent.syn_en: Read it as a methodological specimen: how a Chinese official breaks an unfamiliar country into writable, comparable modules. Then read Dai to see record turn into judgement.

plot_acts.zh: 从神权性的皇权入手，指出日本国体的特殊结构，及其如何为近代国家提供合法性。
plot_acts.en: Starting from the sacred throne, it identifies the peculiar structure of the Japanese polity and how it lent legitimacy to the modern state.
plot_acts.sources: 篇目概述

plot_acts.zh: 论宗教情感与武士伦理如何合成一套可动员的精神装置；这一层与《武士道》互为参照。
plot_acts.en: How religious feeling and warrior ethics fuse into a mobilisable spiritual apparatus; here it mirrors Bushido.
plot_acts.sources: 篇目概述

plot_acts.zh: 收在日本的对外行为方式上：知日的终点不是趣味，而是判断它下一步会怎样。
plot_acts.en: It closes on Japan's conduct abroad: knowing Japan ends not in curiosity but in judging what it will do next.
plot_acts.sources: 篇目概述

craft.zh: 以论断带材料：先给判断，再举见闻，不作学院式铺陈。
craft.en: Judgement carries the material: the verdict first, the observation after, with no academic scaffolding.

craft.zh: 政治家的文体：短句、断语、直接面向行动。
craft.en: A politician's prose: short sentences, verdicts, addressed to action.

craft.zh: 与《日本国志》构成「志」与「论」的对照：一记录，一判断。
craft.en: It pairs with the gazetteer as record against judgement.

motifs.evid_zh: 戴季陶把皇权视为理解日本政治的第一把钥匙。
motifs.evid_en: Dai treats the throne as the first key to Japanese politics.

motifs.evid_zh: 认识日本的目的，是判断与应对，而非鉴赏。
motifs.evid_en: The purpose of knowing Japan is judgement and response, not appreciation.

motifs.evid_zh: 作为伦理解释日本行动力的枢纽概念。
motifs.evid_en: The hinge concept for explaining Japan's capacity for action.

excerpts.trans_zh: 戴季陶用二十四篇短论逐步逼近日本：先拆皇权与国体的神圣外衣，再论信仰与武士道如何把伦理组织成动员，最后落到风俗与对外性格。认识他者，从来连着如何使用这份认识。
excerpts.trans_en: Dai Jitao approaches Japan through twenty-four short essays. He first strips the sacred cover from the throne and the polity, then shows how faith and bushido organise ethics into mobilisation, and ends with custom and conduct abroad. To know the other is always tied to how that knowledge will be used.
excerpts.source: 《日本论》论旨概述 · 据出版说明与通行引述（非逐字）
excerpts.source_en: 日本論: Paraphrase after the publisher's description and standard accounts; not a quotation.

deep_read.zh: 先读论皇权与国体的几篇，再读论武士道的几篇，最后读论风俗与对外性格的几篇，看判断如何从结构推到行动。
deep_read.en: Read the throne and polity pieces, then bushido, then manners and outward character, to watch judgement move from structure to action.

deep_read.zh: 与《菊与刀》对读：一个中国政治家用亲历写，一个美国人类学家用文献写，方法不同，结论却常相邻。
deep_read.en: Read with Benedict: a Chinese politician writes from experience, an American anthropologist from documents; methods differ, conclusions often neighbour.

deep_read.zh: 留意书中对「国民性」的用法，它与后来《菊与刀》的「文化模式」是同一问题的两种问法。
deep_read.en: Note the use of national character: it and Benedict's culture pattern are two ways of asking one question.

books.why_zh: 《分身》自陈的直接前身之一。它把「知日」从志书的记录推进为对日的判断：认识他者，从来连着如何使用这份认识。
books.why_en: A predecessor Avatar names outright. It pushes knowing Japan from gazetteer record to judgement: knowing the other is always bound to how that knowledge is used.

background.zh: 戴季陶（1891—1949）早年留日，后任孙中山秘书，是国民党理论家。《日本论》1928 年由上海民智书局初版，胡汉民作序，收二十四篇短文，论皇权、国体、信仰、武士道、风俗与日本的对外性格。与黄遵宪的志书不同，它不作系统记录，而以论断带材料，是一本「对日」的书：写作动机里有革命政治的现实焦虑。
background.en: Dai Jitao (1891-1949) studied in Japan and later served as Sun Yat-sen's secretary, becoming a Kuomintang theorist. A Discussion of Japan appeared from Shanghai Minzhi in 1928 with a preface by Hu Hanmin: twenty-four short pieces on the throne, the polity, faith, bushido, manners and Japan's outward character. Unlike Huang's gazetteer it records nothing systematically; judgement carries the material. It is a book written facing Japan, with the practical anxiety of revolutionary politics behind it.
background.conf: ✓ 初版信息；论述归类为导读性概述 ◐
background.conf_en: ✓ first edition; the thematic grouping is a reading summary ◐

narrative.zh: 二十四篇短论可以看作一台逐步逼近的装置：先论皇权与国体，说明日本政治的神圣外衣；再论信仰与武士道，说明伦理如何被组织成动员；最后论风俗与对外性格，落到行动。每篇都短，判断都硬。
narrative.en: The twenty-four pieces form a closing-in device: the throne and polity first, showing the sacred dress of Japanese politics; faith and bushido next, showing how ethics is organised for mobilisation; manners and outward character last, arriving at action. Each piece is short, each judgement hard.

intent.reception_good_zh: 民国日本论的代表作，二十四篇短论至今可读。它把国体、武士道、信仰与对外性格串成一套解释，比同时代游记更直接，也为后来的「国民性」讨论立了样本。
intent.reception_good_en: The representative Republican-era discussion of Japan; its twenty-four pieces remain readable. It links polity, bushido, faith and outward character into one explanation, more direct than contemporary travel writing, and set a model for later national-character debate.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 政论先行的代价是材料服从判断；对皇权与「国民性」的处理带有强烈的时代政治投影，后世常被指为以论代史。
intent.reception_bad_en: Policy first, material second: the treatment of the throne and national character carries the political projections of its moment, and later readers have called it argument in place of history.
intent.syn_zh: 与《日本国志》对读，一记录一判断；与《菊与刀》对读，一亲历一文献。三者并置，正好看出「知日」的三种姿势。
intent.syn_en: Read with Huang for record against judgement; with Benedict for experience against documents. Set together, the three show three postures of knowing Japan.

books.domain: 文化人类学 · 日本研究

plot_acts.zh: 说明战时研究的条件：不能实地调查，只能以文献、访谈与影像推断；方法上的限制同时也是结论的限度。
plot_acts.en: The wartime condition: no fieldwork, only documents, interviews and film; the methodological limit is also the limit of the conclusions.
plot_acts.sources: 第一章

plot_acts.title_zh: 义务的体系：恩、义理、忠、孝
plot_acts.zh: 全书最密的部分：把日本人的道德生活拆成几组互不重叠又互相拉扯的义务，说明「各安其分」如何运作。
plot_acts.en: The densest part: Japanese moral life split into overlapping and pulling obligations, showing how 'each in his place' operates.
plot_acts.sources: 第二至十章

plot_acts.zh: 从自我修养与儿童养育解释人格如何被养成，最后论战败后的转向：同一套装置如何解释投降后的顺从。
plot_acts.en: Self-cultivation and child-rearing explain how character is formed; the close asks how the same apparatus explains compliance after surrender.
plot_acts.sources: 第十一至十三章

craft.zh: 文化模式：把散乱的风俗归纳成可命名的整体，代价是抹平内部差异。
craft.en: Culture pattern: scattered customs reduced to a nameable whole, at the cost of internal difference.

craft.zh: 对照法：几乎每个日本特征都配一个美国反例，读者被安置在比较的位置上。
craft.en: Contrast: nearly every Japanese trait gets an American counter-example, placing the reader in comparison.

craft.zh: 战时文体：结论先行，例证服务于说服，不作学术保留。
craft.en: Wartime prose: conclusions first, evidence in service of persuasion, few academic hedges.

motifs.evid_zh: 与罪感对照：耻来自外部注视，罪来自内在良知。此对照是全书最著名的概括。
motifs.evid_en: Against guilt: shame comes from outside gaze, guilt from inner conscience. The book's most famous contrast.

motifs.evid_zh: 等级秩序被写成日本社会的基本语法。
motifs.evid_en: Hierarchy written as the basic grammar of Japanese society.

motifs.evid_zh: 两组义务构成日本人情与道德之间的张力。
motifs.evid_en: Two sets of obligation generate the tension between feeling and morality.

excerpts.trans_zh: 本尼迪克特在未踏足日本的情况下，以访谈、电影、文学与宣传材料构建「文化模式」。她提出「耻感文化」与「罪感文化」的对照，并逐章拆解恩、义理、忠、孝与人情。结论的可疑处，恰是「从外面给一个文化定型」的方法本身。
excerpts.trans_en: Without ever visiting Japan, Benedict builds a culture pattern from interviews, films, literature and propaganda. She contrasts shame culture with guilt culture and works through on, giri, loyalty, filial piety and human feeling. What is doubtful in the conclusions belongs to the method of typing a culture from outside.
excerpts.source: 《菊与刀》论旨概述 · 据出版说明与通行引述（非逐字）
excerpts.source_en: The Chrysanthemum and the Sword: Paraphrase after the publisher's description and standard accounts; not a quotation.

deep_read.zh: 先读第一章与第十三章，看清方法与结论的边界，再读中间各章，问：哪些材料能支持这个概括，哪些只是战时的推论。
deep_read.en: Read ch. 1 and ch. 13 for the bounds of method and conclusion, then the middle: which evidence supports the pattern, which is wartime inference.

deep_read.zh: 与《武士道》对读：一个是日本人向西方解释自己，一个是美国人替西方解释日本。
deep_read.en: Read with Bushido: one is a Japanese explaining himself to the West, the other an American explaining Japan for the West.

deep_read.zh: 读日译本在日本引发的争论（和辻哲郎、川岛武宜等），看书里的「耻」如何被日本人反驳。
deep_read.en: Follow the Japanese debate the translation provoked (Watsuji, Kawashima and others) to see how 'shame' was rebutted at home.

books.baseline_conf: ✓ 初版 / 中译初版 / 译者 / ISBN 已核；「耻感」概括为二手共识 ◐
books.baseline_conf_en: ✓ first edition, Chinese first edition, translators, ISBN verified; the shame summary is secondary consensus ◐
books.why_zh: 战后一切日本论，包括它的批判者，都绕不开的对手。读它不是为了接受结论，而是为了看清「从外面给一个文化定型」这件事怎么做成、又错在哪。
books.why_en: The rival every post-war Japan-ology, its critics included, must pass through. One reads it not to accept its conclusions but to see how typing a culture from outside is done, and where it goes wrong.

background.zh: 本尼迪克特（1887—1948）受美国战时机构委托研究日本，在未踏足日本的情况下，以日俘访谈、电影、文学与宣传材料构建「文化模式」。1946 年由 Houghton Mifflin 出版，全书十三章，从「任务：研究日本」到「投降后的日本人」。核心概念是耻感与罪感的对照、恩与义理的张力、忠与孝的层级，以及「各安其分」的等级观。日译本 1948 年出版后在日本成为畅销书，也引发持续的方法论争论。
background.en: Benedict (1887-1948) was commissioned by a wartime US agency and, without ever going to Japan, built a culture pattern from prisoner interviews, films, literature and propaganda. Houghton Mifflin published it in 1946 in thirteen chapters, from 'Assignment: Japan' to 'The Japanese Since VJ-Day'. Its core concepts are shame against guilt, on and giri in tension, the tiers of chu and ko, and a hierarchy in which each keeps his place. The Japanese translation of 1948 became a bestseller and started a lasting methodological argument.
background.conf: ✓ 出版与章节；概念概括为二手共识 ◐

narrative.zh: 写法是「先设难题，再拆装置」：第一章说明为何必须研究一个从未见过的敌国；随后逐章拆解日本人的义务体系（恩、义理、忠、孝）、情义与人情、道德困境、自我修养、儿童养育，最后以战败后的适应收束。人类学的比较法贯穿全书，日本常被放在与美国的对照中定义。
narrative.en: The method is to pose the problem, then dismantle the apparatus: chapter one explains why an unseen enemy must be studied; later chapters take apart the Japanese system of obligations (on, giri, chu, ko), obligation versus human feeling, moral dilemmas, self-cultivation, child-rearing, closing with post-defeat adaptation. Anthropological comparison runs throughout: Japan is often defined against America.

intent.reception_good_zh: 战后日本研究无法绕开的起点。「文化模式」的方法影响了整个战后人类学与日本论；日译本畅销，也使它反过来成为日本人的自我认识材料。
intent.reception_good_en: The unavoidable starting point of post-war Japan studies. The culture-pattern method shaped post-war anthropology and Japan-ology, and the bestselling Japanese translation turned it back into material for Japanese self-understanding.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 未做田野、依赖战时材料，把日本写成整全同质的模式；「耻感文化」的二分被和辻哲郎、川岛武宜等人批评为以西方伦理为隐含标准。
intent.reception_bad_en: No fieldwork, wartime sources, Japan written as a whole homogeneous pattern; the shame-culture dichotomy was criticised by Watsuji Tetsuro, Kawashima Takeyoshi and others for tacitly measuring Japan against Western ethics.
intent.syn_zh: 读它要读两层：一层是 1946 年美国人如何为占领政策理解日本，一层是这套模式后来如何被日本人与中国学者反复引用与反驳。
intent.syn_en: Read two layers: how Americans understood Japan for occupation policy in 1946, and how the pattern was later cited and rebutted by Japanese and Chinese scholars.

plot_acts.zh: 指出日本文化的纯粹性是一种近代建构，用来对抗西方，也用来压抑内部差异。
plot_acts.en: Japanese cultural purity is a modern construct, used against the West and against internal difference.

plot_acts.zh: 反驳「日本只会模仿」：模仿之所以成立，是因为有一套强健的消化与改造机制。
plot_acts.en: Against the charge of mere imitation: imitation works only through a robust apparatus of digestion and remaking.

plot_acts.zh: 把夹杂本身立为方法：不纯粹的诚实，正是日本文化面对世界时的创造力。

craft.zh: 论战性：直接回应「日本特殊论」与「模仿论」两派。

motifs.evid_zh: 承认夹杂，反而获得面对世界的底气。

excerpts.trans_zh: 加藤周一先破两极：纯粹传统是近代发明，模仿论又低估了消化能力。随后他把「杂种」立为正面概念。日本文化的力量不在纯度，而在把异质成分反复杂交、生成新形式的能力。
excerpts.trans_en: Kato Shuichi first breaks both poles: pure tradition is a modern invention, and the imitation thesis underestimates digestion. He then makes hybridity a positive concept. The strength of Japanese culture lies not in purity but in repeatedly crossing heterogeneous elements into new forms.

books.why_zh: 《菊与刀》式定型论之后，日本人对自己的又一记回答。它拒绝「纯粹传统」与「全盘西化」这两极，把夹杂本身说成创造力的来源。
books.why_en: Japan's own answer after Benedict's typing. It refuses both pure tradition and wholesale westernisation, locating creativity in the mixture itself.

background.zh: 加藤周一（1919—2008）医学出身而转向评论，是战后日本最具公共性的文化批评者之一。1956 年讲谈社出版《雑種文化：日本的小希望》，同名长文提出：日本文化既非纯粹的传统，也非单纯的模仿，而是西方与东方、传统与现代长期交配而成的「杂种文化」；其纯粹性本为虚构，其创造力恰在「不纯粹的诚实」。中译有 1991 年 3 月吉林人民出版社《日本文化的杂种性》（杨铁婴译，231 页），以及 2000 年光明日报出版社《日本文化论》（470 页，含「杂种文化论」与「日本现代模式论」）。
background.en: Kato Shuichi (1919-2008) trained in medicine and turned to criticism, becoming one of post-war Japan's most public culture critics. Kodansha published Hybrid Culture: Japan's Small Hope in 1956; its long title essay argues that Japanese culture is neither pure tradition nor mere imitation but a hybrid bred over centuries from East and West, tradition and modernity. Its purity was always a fiction; its creativity lies precisely in an honest impurity. Chinese versions include Jilin People's Press, The Hybridity of Japanese Culture (trans. Yang Tieying, 231 pp, March 1991), and Guangming Daily Press, Theories of Japanese Culture (470 pp, 2000).

narrative.zh: 论证是「先破两极，再立中间」：先指出「纯粹文化」是一种近代发明，再指出「模仿论」低估了消化能力，最后以杂种的活力收束。加藤的写法兼有评论家的明快与医生的解剖感，概念少，例子多。
narrative.en: The argument breaks the two poles before building the middle: pure culture is a modern invention; the imitation thesis underestimates digestion; hybrid vigour closes the case. Kato writes with a critic's briskness and a physician's anatomy, few concepts and many examples.

intent.reception_good_en: A key post-war text in Japanese cultural theory, dismantling both pure tradition and wholesale westernisation; hybridity became a standard term for describing Japanese culture and shaped later debates on cultural mixture.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 概念宽泛，几乎可解释一切，反而难以证伪；对「杂种」的肯定也容易被读成对近代化的让步。

plot_acts.zh: 画家离城入山，开篇即立「非人情」之论：人世难居，故以诗画之眼观之。
plot_acts.en: The painter leaves the city; the opening establishes disinterestedness: the world is hard to live in, so see it with a poet's and painter's eye.

background.zh: 《草枕》1906 年发表，是漱石继《我是猫》《哥儿》之后的第三部中篇。叙述者是一位画家，为避开尘世而走入山中温泉，遇见当地女子那美。全书以画家的眼观看世界：不以人情介入，而以画意观照。开篇「智に働けば角が立つ」一段，是日本近代文学最著名的开头之一，也把全书的「非人情」主张一次说尽。
background.en: Published in 1906, Kusamakura is Soseki's third novella after I Am a Cat and Botchan. The narrator, a painter, withdraws to a mountain spa and meets a local woman, Nami. The whole book sees through a painter's eye: not emotional involvement but pictorial contemplation. Its opening, 'Work by intellect and you grow angular', is one of the most famous in modern Japanese literature and states the creed of disinterestedness in a breath.

background.conf_en: ✓ year and plot outline; the gloss on disinterestedness is standard reading ◐

narrative.zh: 结构是「行走—观察—作画」：没有强情节，靠视角的移动推进。画家一路记下风景、人物与议论，议论与写景交替，最后以一幅未完成的画收束。它更像一部以小说形式写的诗论。
narrative.en: The structure is walk, observe, paint: no strong plot, movement carried by shifts of viewpoint. The painter records scenery, people and reflection in alternation, closing on an unfinished picture. It reads as a poetics written in the form of fiction.

intent.reception_good_zh: 日本近代文学中最彻底的一次「非人情」实践；开篇一段被反复引用，成为漱石美学的入口，也让「以画意观世」成为此后日本美学的常用语。
intent.reception_good_en: The most thorough exercise in disinterestedness in modern Japanese literature; its opening is endlessly quoted, the gateway to Soseki's aesthetics, and 'seeing the world pictorially' became a staple phrase.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 情节稀薄，议论过多，常被读作「以小说写诗论」；「非人情」的立场也被批评为对现实的逃避。
intent.reception_bad_en: Thin plot and abundant reflection make it a poetics in novel form; the stance of disinterestedness has also been criticised as flight from reality.

excerpts.trans_zh: 《侏儒的话》没有连续结构，一段一个判断，判断之间互相拆台。芥川的自嘲不是谦辞，而是一种方法：先把话说得极漂亮，再亲手拆掉它的地基，让读者看见修辞底下的虚空。
excerpts.trans_en: Tsukurou no kotoba has no continuous structure. Each paragraph is a judgement, and the judgements undercut one another. Akutagawa's self-mockery is not modesty but method: say a thing beautifully, then remove its foundation so that the void under the rhetoric becomes visible.

books.why_zh: 读《妄想者手记》时最好的箴语对读本。手记是长的自剖，侏儒的话是短的自嘲，两者合起来才是一个完整的芥川。
books.why_en: The best aphoristic companion to the Visionary volume. The notebook is long self-dissection, Dwarf's Words short self-mockery; together they make a whole Akutagawa.

background.zh: 《侏儒的话》写于大正十二年（1923）至昭和二年（1927），是芥川晚年的箴语、随笔与短章结集，因作者 1927 年自杀而成为遗作之一。他以「侏儒」自况：身材小，故敢说大人不敢说的话；姿态低，故看得见高处的破绽。内容遍及人生、道德、艺术、政治、恋爱与社交，句句短峭，常以反转收束。中译有河北教育出版社 2002 年 6 月版，以及广西师范大学出版社 2024 年 4 月邹波译《侏儒的话：士说新语》。
background.en: Written between 1923 and 1927 and gathered as aphorisms, sketches and short pieces, Dwarf's Words became one of Akutagawa's posthumous works after his suicide in 1927. He takes the dwarf as his figure: small in stature, therefore free to say what giants dare not; low in position, therefore able to see the cracks above. The subjects run through life, morals, art, politics, love and society, each sentence short and often turning on a reversal. Chinese editions include Hebei Education (June 2002) and Guangxi Normal University Press (April 2024, trans. Zou Bo).
background.conf: ✓ 写作年代与中译；篇目为概述 ◐
background.conf_en: ✓ writing span and Chinese editions; contents summarised ◐

narrative.zh: 没有连续结构，靠「段」的排列形成节奏：一段一个判断，判断之间互相拆台。读法上不必顺序，随手翻到哪段都能成立，但连读会发现一个逐渐冷下去的声音。
narrative.en: There is no continuous structure; rhythm comes from the arrangement of fragments, one judgement per paragraph, each undermining the last. It need not be read in order, yet read through it reveals a voice growing colder.

excerpts.trans_zh: 晚年的荷风把舞台放回隅田川以东的玉之井，写小说家大江匡与娼妇阿雪的往来。季节推移带动叙述，相遇与告别代替冲突；挽歌的调子从头到尾不散，因为要凭吊的不只是人，还有正在消失的下町。

books.why_zh: 《异国放浪记》的向内侧影：一个向外流亡，一个向内凭吊。荷风用晚年的一支笔，为正在消失的东京下町写挽歌。
books.why_en: The inward shadow of Wandering Abroad: one exile outward, one mourning inward. With a late style, Kafu writes an elegy for a vanishing low town.

background.zh: 《濹东绮谭》1937 年发表，是永井荷风（1879—1959）晚年的代表作。「濹东」指隅田川以东的下町，小说以玉之井一带的私娼窟为舞台，写小说家大江匡与娼妇阿雪的交往，同时记四季风物与社会世相。荷风早年留学美、法，写《美国故事》《法国故事》，归国后转向江户趣味，以「断肠亭主人」之名写日记，本书即那部日记的小说化。中译由谭晶华翻译，上海译文出版社出版。
background.en: Published in 1937, Bokuto Kidan is a late masterpiece of Nagai Kafu (1879-1959). 'Bokuto' is the low town east of the Sumida; the novella is set among the unlicensed brothels of Tamanoi and follows the novelist Oe Kyo and the woman Oyuki, recording the seasons and the social weather along the way. Kafu had studied in America and France, written American and French stories, and on returning turned to Edo taste, keeping the diary under the name Duanchang-ting. The novella fictionalises that diary. Tan Jinghua's Chinese translation is published by Shanghai Translation.

background.conf_en: ✓ work and Chinese edition; the diary-to-fiction relation is standard ◐

narrative.zh: 结构松散如四季：以季节推移带动叙述，人物关系不靠冲突推进，而靠相遇与告别。荷风的句子慢，细节密，风景与身体并置，挽歌的调子从头到尾不散。
narrative.en: The structure is loose as the seasons: time carries the narrative, and relationships advance through meetings and partings rather than conflict. Kafu's sentences are slow, details dense, landscape and body placed side by side, the elegiac tone unbroken.

craft.zh: 日语讲演：以本国语言的节奏面对世界，本身就是一次立场声明。

books.baseline_conf: ✓ 讲演日期 / 原题 / 中译已核（旧稿原题「美しい日本と私」已订正）

books.why_zh: 全篇美学自述的收束点，「温柔哀感」在二十世纪的最后回响。川端不讲理论，只把几首和歌、几处庭园、几只茶碗摆在一起，让美自己说话。
books.why_en: The closing self-portrait, and the twentieth century's last echo of tender grief. Kawabata offers no theory: a few waka, a few gardens, a few tea bowls, and beauty speaks for itself.

background.zh: 1968 年 12 月 12 日，川端康成在斯德哥尔摩以日语发表诺贝尔文学奖纪念讲演《美しい日本の私――その序説》，英译本题为 Japan, the Beautiful and Myself。讲演由道元禅师的和歌「春は花 夏ほととぎす 秋は月 冬雪さえて すずしかりけり」开篇，继而说明惠、良宽、一休、亲鸾，论枯山水、茶道、花道与俳谐，把日本之美归为对空无与无常的亲近。中译有河北教育出版社 2002 年叶渭渠译《我在美丽的日本》（「东瀛美文之旅」丛书），另有版本题作《美丽的日本与我》。
background.en: On 12 December 1968 Kawabata delivered his Nobel lecture in Japanese at Stockholm under the title Utsukushii Nihon no Watashi: sono josetsu, translated as Japan, the Beautiful and Myself. It opens with Dogen's waka, 'In spring, flowers; in summer, the cuckoo; in autumn, the moon; in winter, snow, clear and cool', then moves through Myoe, Ryokan, Ikkyu and Shinran, treating dry gardens, tea, flower arrangement and haiku, and tracing Japanese beauty to an intimacy with emptiness and impermanence. Ye Weiqu's Chinese translation appeared from Hebei Education in 2002 as Japan the Beautiful and Myself; some editions use the title The Beautiful Japan and I.
background.conf: ✓ 讲演信息；美学概括为通行解读 ◐
background.conf_en: ✓ lecture facts; the aesthetic summary is standard reading ◐

narrative.zh: 讲演没有论证链条，而以「引诗—解诗—转入下一物」的方式推进。每一段都从一句古典和歌起，落到一个具体的器物或场所，再滑向无常之感。最后回到「我」：一个站在空无前面的日本人。
narrative.en: The lecture has no chain of argument; it proceeds by quoting a poem, glossing it, and moving to the next object. Each passage starts from a classical waka, lands on a vessel or a place, and slides toward impermanence. It ends on the 'I': a Japanese standing before emptiness.

quotes.trans_en: In spring, flowers; in summer, the cuckoo; in autumn, the moon; in winter, snow, clear and cool. (our translation)

quotes.source_en: lecture opening · Dogen's waka ✓

intent.reception_good_zh: 诺奖讲演的经典文本，以极简的物象说尽日本美学的核心；以日语讲演本身即是文化立场的声明，中译本长期是进入川端美学的第一扇门。
intent.reception_good_en: A canonical Nobel text, saying the core of Japanese aesthetics through minimal objects; delivering it in Japanese was itself a cultural stance, and the Chinese translation has long been the first door into Kawabata's aesthetics.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 把日本美写成连续的、无历史的传统，略去近代断裂；「空无」的概括也被后来的研究者视为过度统一。
intent.reception_bad_en: Japanese beauty is written as a continuous, unhistorical tradition with modern ruptures omitted; the summary of emptiness has been seen by later scholars as over-unified.
intent.syn_zh: 与《茶之书》对读，看外宣与自述的差别；与《日本侘寂》对读，看「空无」如何被概念化。
intent.syn_en: Read with The Book of Tea for export against self-portrait; with Japanese Wabi-Sabi for how emptiness becomes a concept.

books.why_zh: 英语世界最贴近「围棋与观心」的文集：多数文章先在《空枰》专栏发表，主题集中在围棋如何与佛教的「觉悟」相联。
books.why_en: The English collection closest to 'Go and watching the mind': most essays first appeared in The Empty Board column and centre on how Go relates to Buddhist enlightenment.

background.zh: Cobb 在《美国围棋杂志》写《空枰》专栏多年，2005 年由 Slate and Shell 结集为本书；出版社简介称多数文章聚焦围棋与佛教「求觉悟」的关系，也兼及足球、魔鬼等题目。德译本《Das leere Brett》2012 年由 Brett und Stein 出版。
background.en: Cobb wrote The Empty Board for the American Go Journal for years; Slate and Shell collected the essays in 2005. The publisher says most focus on Go's relation to the Buddhist search for enlightenment, while also touching football and demons. A German translation, Das leere Brett, appeared from Brett und Stein in 2012.

narrative.zh: 不是体系性论著，而是按篇组织的随笔：每篇从一个具体的棋局经验或生活类比出发，转入佛教概念（无常、执著、无我、觉悟），再回到棋。读法上宜把它当「思想随笔」而非「佛教教义书」。
narrative.en: Not a systematic treatise but a sequence of essays: each starts from a concrete Go experience or everyday analogy, turns to a Buddhist concept (impermanence, attachment, no-self, enlightenment), then returns to the board. Read it as intellectual essays, not a Buddhist doctrinal manual.

intent.reception_good_zh: 出版社与书目均强调其「英语世界少见的围棋—佛教」主题；具体书评待补。
intent.reception_good_en: Publisher and bibliographic sources stress its rare English-language Go–Buddhism theme; specific reviews pending.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 风险在于把佛教概念当作解释框架时，容易忽略教义内部的差异；且文集非系统论证，不宜当作佛教哲学的入门。
intent.reception_bad_en: The risk is treating Buddhist concepts as a single explanatory frame, flattening internal differences; as a collection it is not a systematic argument and should not serve as an introduction to Buddhist philosophy.
intent.syn_zh: 先读其「问题」而非「结论」：Cobb 关心的不是证明围棋必然通向觉悟，而是描述一种可经验的关联。
intent.syn_en: Read the questions rather than the conclusions: Cobb describes an experiential connection, not a proof that Go must lead to enlightenment.

craft.zh: 以「空枰」为总意象，把开局前的可能性与佛教的「空」并置。

craft.zh: 以「胜负」为核心问题，把赢/输转成执著与放下的观察。

deep_read.zh: 与吴清源《中的精神》对读「超越胜负」：Cobb 走佛教路线，吴清源走中和路线；比较两者的「放下」是否同义。

deep_read.zh: 把「四法印」当作假设，逐篇检验；不要用它代替原文。
deep_read.en: Treat the four principles as a hypothesis to test essay by essay, not a substitute for the text.

reception.then_zh: 2005 年由 Slate and Shell 出版，116 页；多数文章原为《空枰》专栏。德译本《Das leere Brett》2012 年由 Brett und Stein 出版。

reception.later_zh: AGA 2019 年的回顾把 Cobb 的贡献概括为「让棋手更深入地思考为何热爱围棋」，并复述其四法印框架。
reception.later_en: An AGA retrospective in 2019 credits Cobb with making players think more deeply about why they love Go, and restates his four-principles frame.
reception.influence_zh: 为英语世界的「围棋—佛教」写作提供了可引的先例；Cobb 2021 年的书延续同一问题。
reception.influence_en: Provides a citable English precedent for Go–Buddhism writing; Cobb's 2021 book continues the question.
reception.critique_zh: 文集非系统论证；佛教概念在跨文化转写中容易被压平；「足球与魔鬼」等题目显示其随笔性。
reception.critique_en: A collection rather than a system; Buddhist concepts can be flattened in cross-cultural transfer; topics such as football and demons show its occasional nature.

limits.zh: 以下为结构层面的可能局限，不是对全文的判断（未通读）。

items.note_zh: 文章按篇累积，论证依赖重复而非一章一证。
items.note_en: The case accumulates essay by essay; argument relies on repetition rather than a single chain.

items.note_zh: 以「四法印」概括佛教，可能忽略教派差异。
items.note_en: Summarising Buddhism as four principles may blur sectarian differences.

items.note_zh: 把围棋与觉悟相连是 Cobb 的主张，不是已被证明的因果。
items.note_en: Linking Go to enlightenment is Cobb's claim, not a proven causal relation.

author_intent.claim_zh: Cobb 要证明：围棋可以是一种佛教实践，而不只是佛教隐喻。他的论证不是一次性的体系，而是专栏多年的累积：以空枰、互连、无常、无我四个意象，反复把棋局经验翻译成佛教经验。
author_intent.claim_en: Cobb wants to show that Go can be a Buddhist practice, not merely a Buddhist metaphor. The argument is not a one-off system but years of columns accumulating: empty board, interconnectedness, impermanence and no-self repeatedly translate board experience into Buddhist experience.
author_intent.why_zh: 出版社简介明确说多数文章聚焦围棋与佛教「求觉悟」的关系；AGA 2019 年的回顾把其核心概括为「空枰」「互连」「无常」「无我」，并引「赢棋不可能是好事，因为输棋并不坏」；Tricycle 1999 年的改写本把围棋与茶道、空手道并列为「求觉悟」的实践。三处独立来源指向同一意图。
author_intent.why_en: The publisher says most essays concern Go and the Buddhist search for enlightenment; the AGA retrospective reduces Cobb to empty board, interconnectedness, impermanence and no-self, quoting 'it cannot be good to win, because it is not bad to lose'; the 1999 Tricycle adaptation places Go beside tea ceremony and karate as a practice of enlightenment. Three independent sources point to one intent.

evidence.zh: Slate and Shell 2005，116 页；多数文章原为《空枰》专栏。
evidence.en: Slate and Shell 2005, 116 pp.; most essays from The Empty Board.

evidence.zh: 出版社称多数文章聚焦围棋与佛教「求觉悟」的关系。
evidence.en: Publisher says most essays focus on Go and the Buddhist search for enlightenment.

evidence.en: AGA 2019 restates the four-principles frame and the win/lose proposition.

evidence.zh: 1999 年 Tricycle 改写本把围棋与茶道、空手道并列为求觉悟的实践。
evidence.en: The 1999 Tricycle adaptation places Go beside tea ceremony and karate as practice.

evidence.zh: Cobb 为哲学教授、日本棋院国际围棋讲师，兼具概念训练与棋艺教学。
evidence.en: Cobb is a philosophy professor and Nihon Kiin instructor, combining conceptual training with Go teaching.

evidence.zh: 德译本 2012 年出版，说明其问题跨语言被接受。

author_intent.counter_zh: 另一种读法：这是一部「围棋随笔集」，四法印是 AGA 回顾者的概括，不一定等于 Cobb 的统一体系；各篇可能只共享问题，而不共享论证。若如此，不应用「四法印」当作全书结构。
author_intent.counter_en: Alternative reading: this is a collection of Go essays; the four principles are the retrospective writer's summary, not necessarily Cobb's unified system. The pieces may share a question rather than an argument. On that reading, do not use the four principles as the book's structure.
author_intent.boundary_zh: 未读原文，无法判断各篇是否真的围绕四法印展开；上述推断依据出版社简介、AGA 回顾与 Tricycle 改写本，推断本身标 ◐。
author_intent.boundary_en: Without the essays I cannot tell whether each piece really turns on the four principles; the inference rests on the publisher blurb, the AGA retrospective and the Tricycle adaptation, and is marked ◐.

review.title_zh: 空枰上的四法印：Cobb 的围棋—佛教随笔
review.title_en: Four principles on an empty board
review.standfirst_zh: 一部由专栏累积而成的文集：它要证明围棋可以是佛教实践，而不只是佛教隐喻。
review.standfirst_en: A collection accumulated from columns, arguing that Go can be a Buddhist practice rather than a Buddhist metaphor.
review.body_zh:
《Reflections on the Game of Go》是 Cobb 多年《空枰》专栏的结集。它的论点不在某一篇，而在累积：围棋可以是一种佛教实践，而不只是佛教隐喻。出版社简介说多数文章聚焦围棋与佛教「求觉悟」的关系；AGA 2019 年的回顾把 Cobb 的核心概括为「空枰」「互连」「无常」「无我」，并引他的话说「赢棋不可能是好事，因为输棋并不坏」。

这本文集的价值，是它把英语世界长期缺失的「围棋—佛教」线索补上。它的局限也明显：专栏体不是系统论证，佛教概念在跨文化转写中容易被压平。读它时应把「问题」与「结论」分开：Cobb 描述一种可经验的关联，而不是证明围棋必然通向觉悟。

最可检验的一点，是他对「胜负」的处理：如果输赢被放在「四法印」的框架里，那么棋手的贪、惧、怒就不再只是心理状态，而是可观察的执著。这也是全书最值得与吴清源的「中和」对读的地方：一个从佛教出发，一个从阴阳平衡出发，都在谈「超越胜负」，但路径不同。
review.abstract_en:
Reflections on the Game of Go gathers years of Cobb's Empty Board columns. Its argument is cumulative rather than local: Go can be a Buddhist practice, not merely a Buddhist metaphor. The publisher says most essays concern Go and the search for enlightenment; an AGA retrospective reduces Cobb to empty board, interconnectedness, impermanence and no-self, quoting his claim that it cannot be good to win because it is not bad to lose.

The book's value is to supply the English-language Go–Buddhism line that had been missing. Its limit is equally clear: a column is not a system, and Buddhist concepts can be flattened in cross-cultural transfer. Read the question apart from the conclusion: Cobb describes an experiential connection, not a proof that Go must lead to enlightenment.

The most testable move is his treatment of winning and losing. Once win and loss are placed inside the four-principles frame, greed, fear and anger become observable attachments rather than mere psychology. This is also where the book should be read against Wu Qingyuan's equilibrium: one starts from Buddhism, the other from yin-yang balance; both go beyond winning, by different routes.

Cobb 的佛教进路有一条可核的前史：1997 年在《The Eastern Buddhist》（New Series 30:2, 199–213）发表《The Game of Go: An Unexpected Path to Enlightenment》，1999 年在 Tricycle 春季号发表改写本《The Game of Go》。2021 年的书可视为同一问题意识的延长，但三者的展开、改写或重合关系尚未核实。
background.en:
The listing says the book first introduces basic Buddhist philosophy, then discusses its links to Go in a series of essays. Its relation to the 2005 collection (expansion, rewrite, or separate work) is unverified.

Cobb's Buddhist line has a checkable prehistory: 'The Game of Go: An Unexpected Path to Enlightenment' in The Eastern Buddhist (New Series 30:2, 199–213, 1997), and a 1999 Tricycle adaptation. The 2021 book can be read as a continuation of the same question, but expansion/rewrite/overlap is unverified.

narrative.zh:
据书目描述，结构是「原理先行—应用随后」：先给出佛教哲学的核心概念，再逐篇把它们与围棋经验对齐。具体章节与篇幅待取得原书后补。

若把论文、改写本与书并读，可追问：1997 年的论证在 2021 年被展开成体系，还是被改写为通俗文章？在未核前，不要把三者互相补全。
narrative.en:
Per the listing, the structure is principles-first, application-second: core Buddhist concepts, then essays aligning them with Go experience. Chapters and length await the book.

Read the paper, the adaptation and the book together and ask whether the 1997 argument is expanded into a system or rewritten for a general readership; do not fill gaps in one from another before verification.

review.title_zh: 原理先行的佛教—围棋导论：读 Cobb 的 2021 年小书
review.title_en: A principles-first introduction to Go and Buddhism
review.standfirst_zh: 一本 106 页的自出版小书：它要把佛教哲学的基本原理与围棋经验对齐，而不是重复专栏文集。
review.standfirst_en: A 106-page self-published book that aligns basic Buddhist philosophy with Go experience rather than repeating the columns.
review.body_zh:
Cobb 的佛教—围棋写作有一条清晰的时间线：1997 年的《The Eastern Buddhist》论文、1999 年 Tricycle 的改写本、2005 年的专栏文集，再到 2021 年这本 106 页的小书。与前面的文本相比，本书的野心更「教学化」：先把佛教哲学的基本原理讲清，再用系列文章把它们与围棋经验对齐。

这使它的价值与风险都很明确。价值在于，它为不熟悉佛教的棋手提供了一条入口：先懂原理，再看棋局。风险在于，106 页的篇幅与自出版的形式，可能让「原理」停留在导论层面，而「系列文章」仍是旧文的改写；它与《Reflections》的重合度尚未核实，不能互相补全。

最稳妥的读法，是把它当作一本「导论」而非「体系」：先读原理部分，标出他实际使用的佛教概念（空、互连、无常、无我、慈悲），再逐篇问：这些概念是在解释棋局，还是只是被棋局举例？答案会决定这本书是 Cobb 的体系，还是 Cobb 的入门课。
review.abstract_en:
Cobb's Go–Buddhism writing has a clear timeline: the 1997 Eastern Buddhist paper, the 1999 Tricycle adaptation, the 2005 collection of columns, and this 106-page book in 2021. Compared with the earlier texts, the ambition here is more pedagogical: set out the basic principles of Buddhist philosophy, then align them with Go experience in a series of essays.

That makes its value and risk clear. The value is an entry point for players unfamiliar with Buddhism: principles first, then the board. The risk is that 106 pages and self-publication keep the principles at the level of introduction while the essays remain reworked old pieces; overlap with Reflections is unverified and the two must not be used to fill each other.

The safest reading is as an introduction, not a system: read the principles first, mark which Buddhist concepts he actually uses (emptiness, interconnectedness, impermanence, no-self, compassion), then ask essay by essay whether the concepts explain the board or the board merely illustrates them. The answer decides whether this is Cobb's system or Cobb's primer.

review.title_zh: 先学会吃子：Cobb 的入门教学法
review.standfirst_zh: Cobb 的入门书把「规则复杂度」当作初学者的真正瓶颈，因此先教「先吃子版」，再过渡到完整围棋。
review.standfirst_en: Cobb's primer treats rule complexity as the beginner's real bottleneck, teaching First-Capture Go before full Go.
review.body_zh:
《The Book of Go》是 Cobb 的入门教材，也是理解他「技术教师」一面的关键。它的设计很激进：第二章不是完整规则，而是「先吃子版围棋」——先只教吃子，把规则复杂度降到最低，再在后续章节引入连接、眼与活、战略、战术与受子。

这套设计的假设是：初学者的瓶颈不是计算，而是规则太多。书附 9×9 与 13×13 棋具，目录以棋谚与练习收束，说明它追求的是「立刻能下、可记忆、可练习」。Cobb 在学校与大学教过大量初学者，这一设计有教学经验基础。

它的局限也在这里：作为入门书，它不处理高级战略与全局判断；而「规则复杂度是瓶颈」本身是一个可争议的教学假设。读它时不妨把它当一次教学实验：先吃子版是否真的让初学者更快进入完整围棋？如果是，它的价值就超出「又一本入门书」。
review.abstract_en:
The Book of Go is Cobb's primer and the key to his 'teacher' side. Its design is radical: chapter two is not the full rules but First-Capture Go, which teaches capture only and lowers rule complexity, before later chapters introduce connections, eyes and life, strategy, tactics and handicap.

The assumption is that the beginner's bottleneck is not calculation but too many rules. The included 9x9 and 13x13 sets and the closing chapters on proverbs and problems show a pedagogy of 'play at once, remember, practise'. Cobb taught many beginners in schools and colleges, so the design has an experiential basis.

Its limit is the same: as a primer it does not treat advanced strategy or whole-board judgment, and 'rule complexity is the bottleneck' is itself contestable. Read it as a teaching experiment: does First-Capture Go really move beginners faster into full Go? If so, its value exceeds that of another primer.

background.zh: 何云波为湘潭大学文学与新闻学院教授、围棋文化研究中心负责人；本书是国家社科基金项目「中国围棋思想史」的成果。中南大学教授孟泽为本书作序，称围棋深度参与了中国人的日常生活并塑造其人格与精神。
background.en: He Yunbo is a professor at Xiangtan University and heads its Go Culture Research Centre; the book is an output of the NSSF project 'A History of Chinese Go Thought'. Meng Ze of Central South University writes in the preface that Go deeply shaped Chinese daily life, personality and spirit.

narrative.zh: 据作者自述与书评线索，本书不是单纯的棋史，而是把棋论、棋人、制度与思想观念并置：儒家的「立象比德」、道家的「技进乎道」、以及现代「和谐之道」构成几条主线。具体章节结构待原书核对。
narrative.en: Judging from the author's own account and review leads, it is not a bare chronicle but a juxtaposition of treatises, players, institutions and ideas: Confucian 'imaging virtue', Daoist 'skill into the Way', and a modern 'way of harmony'. Chapter structure awaits the book.

author_intent.claim_zh: 何云波要证明：围棋不是「小道」，而是中国思想史的合法对象。他的做法不是抽象地谈「道」，而是把棋论、棋谱、制度与诗文并置，让「道」在具体文本与历史处境中可被检验。
author_intent.claim_en: He wants to show that Go is not a 'minor art' but a legitimate object of Chinese intellectual history. He does not talk about the Way in the abstract; he juxtaposes treatises, records, institutions and poetry so that the Way can be checked in concrete texts.
author_intent.why_zh: 书名把「围棋」与「思想史」直接并置；绪论先谈「写法」与「意义生成」，说明他知道对象需要方法论辩护；六编从先秦到现代转型，结语回到「围棋与中国思想传统」，形成「起源—分化—格套—转型」的长叙事；同期《光明日报》文章把「立象比德—技进乎道—和谐之道」三段并置，可视为全书的压缩版。
author_intent.why_en: The title yokes Go to intellectual history; the introduction argues about method and meaning-generation; six parts run from pre-Qin to modern transformation and close on 'Go and the Chinese thought tradition', forming an origin–differentiation–formula–transformation narrative; his contemporaneous article compresses the book into imaging virtue, skill-into-Way and harmony.

evidence.zh: 六编从先秦到现代转型，结语回到「中国思想传统」。
evidence.en: Six parts run from pre-Qin to modern transformation; the conclusion returns to the Chinese thought tradition.

author_intent.counter_zh: 另一种读法：本书是一部「围棋文化史」，「思想史」是后设框架；棋谱、图像、期刊等章节更像文化史材料，而非严格的思想史论证。若如此，书名承诺的「思想史」应被理解为「以思想为线索的文化史」。
author_intent.counter_en: Alternative reading: this is a cultural history of Go with 'intellectual history' as a retrospective frame; the chapters on records, images and periodicals look more like cultural history than strict argument. On that reading the title promises a cultural history organised by ideas.

review.title_zh: 把「小道」写成思想史：读《中国围棋思想史》的架构
review.title_en: Writing the 'minor art' into intellectual history
review.standfirst_zh: 一部从先秦写到现代转型的围棋观念史：它的野心不在棋谱，而在证明围棋是中国思想的合法对象。
review.standfirst_en: A history of Go ideas from pre-Qin to modernity: its ambition lies not in game records but in making Go a legitimate object of Chinese intellectual history.
review.body_zh:
《中国围棋思想史》的野心，从书名就开始了：它不是「围棋史」，而是「围棋思想史」。这意味着作者要把一个长期被称作「小数」「小道」的游戏，放进中国思想史的正册。全书六编从先秦写到现代转型，绪论先谈「写法」，说明作者清楚：对象不是既定的，需要方法论辩护。

它的方法不是抽象地谈「道」，而是把棋论、棋谱、图像、制度与诗文并置。先秦编处理起源论与儒家围棋观，汉魏编以「玄象思维」「艺的自觉」「兵家话语」展开，唐宋编分出「棋士棋」与「文人棋」并讨论「技—艺—道」，元明编把《玄玄棋经》与明代棋谱、士人话语放在一起，清代编以「格套」概括理论的成熟与封闭，现代编转向期刊与观念的变迁。

这条长叙事最有价值的地方，是给出了一条可复核的文本序列：读者可以沿着目录回到具体棋论，检验「立象比德」「技进乎道」是否真的在文本中成立。它的风险也在这里：思想史的框架可能压过技术史的断裂，而「道」的解释容易把棋论自身的技术语境吸收掉。由于尚未通读，本文只能判断其架构，不能判断各章的证据密度。

更稳妥的读法是把它当作「以思想为线索的文化史」：它的贡献不是给「围棋之道」下终结论，而是提出一套可争论的分期与文本清单。
review.abstract_en:
The ambition of A History of Chinese Go Thought begins with its title: it is not a history of Go but a history of Go thought, an attempt to move a game long dismissed as a minor art into the main register of Chinese intellectual history. The six parts run from pre-Qin to the modern transformation, and the introduction argues about method first, aware that the object itself needs a defence.

The method is not to talk about the Way in the abstract but to juxtapose treatises, game records, images, institutions and poetry. Pre-Qin chapters treat origin myths and the Confucian view; Han–Wei chapters work through cosmological symbolism, the self-consciousness of art and military discourse; Tang–Song chapters separate professional from literati Go and discuss skill, art and the Way; Yuan–Ming chapters place the Gateway to All Marvels beside Ming records and literati writing; Qing chapters use the idea of a 'formula' to name a theory that is mature yet closed; the modern chapters turn to periodicals and conceptual change.

The book's value is the checkable sequence it provides: a reader can follow the contents back into specific treatises and test whether imaging virtue or skill-into-Way really holds in the texts. Its risk is the reverse: an intellectual-history frame can flatten breaks in technical history, and the Way can absorb the technical context of the treatises. Without a full read, this essay can judge the architecture but not the evidence density of each chapter.

The safer reading is to treat it as a cultural history organised by ideas. Its contribution is less a final verdict on the Way of Go than a contestable periodisation and a list of texts that can be argued with.

background.zh:
本书为国家社科基金「中国围棋思想史」研究的成果之一，是何云波对历代围棋论说的选编。它与《中国围棋思想史》互为表里：一为论述，一为文献。

湘潭大学官网把《中国历代围棋棋论选》与《中国围棋思想史》并列为国家社科基金研究成果；《光明日报》2022 年文章亦以两书为该项目的成果。
background.en:
An output of the NSSF 'History of Chinese Go Thought' project, this is He's anthology of historical Go discourse. It pairs with the History as text and commentary: one argues, one presents the documents.

Xiangtan University lists the Selected Treatises together with the History as NSSF outputs; the 2022 Guangming Daily article likewise presents both as project results.

narrative.zh:
选编体：按时代或主题辑录历代棋论，附以导读。具体选目、底本与注释体例待原书核对。

作为选编，它的价值不在提出新论，而在提供可复核的文本序列。读时先看选目的时代分布，再判断《思想史》的分期是否有足够的文献支撑。
narrative.en:
An anthology: treatises arranged by period or theme with editorial guidance. Selection, base texts and annotation await the book.

As an anthology its value is not a new thesis but a checkable textual sequence. First look at the period distribution of the selection, then ask whether the History's periodisation has enough documentary support.
