review.title_zh: 给思想史一个文本底座：读《中国历代围棋棋论选》
review.title_en: A textual base for the history of ideas
review.standfirst_zh: 与《中国围棋思想史》配对的选本：它的价值不在新论，而在让读者回到历代棋论原文。
review.standfirst_en: An anthology paired with the History: its value is not a new thesis but a return to the treatises.
review.body_zh:
《中国历代围棋棋论选》与《中国围棋思想史》同为国家社科基金项目成果。这种「一论一选」的配对，决定了它的性质：它不是普及读物，而是研究工具——给《思想史》的分期与解释提供可复核的文本底座。

它的价值在「序列」：读者可以沿着选目，从先秦到现代，看「立象比德」「技进乎道」「和谐」这些概念在原始棋论中如何出现、变形与收束。它的风险也在「选择」：若选目受「思想史」框架影响，技术类棋论可能被边缘化，选本就会强化它本来要检验的框架。

因此，读它时最好带着两个问题：第一，选目是否覆盖了《思想史》各章的关键文本？第二，未被选入的棋论是否恰好是最难纳入「思想史」的那一类？这两个问题，比「选得全不全」更能检验它的学术价值。
review.abstract_en:
The Selected Go Treatises and A History of Chinese Go Thought are both outputs of the same NSSF project. That argument-plus-anthology pairing defines its nature: it is not a popular reader but a research instrument, supplying a checkable textual base for the History's periodisation and interpretation.

Its value is sequence: following the selection from pre-Qin to modernity, a reader can watch concepts such as imaging virtue, skill-into-Way and harmony emerge, mutate and close in the primary treatises. Its risk is selection: if the anthology is shaped by the History's frame, technical treatises may be marginalised and the anthology will reinforce the very frame it should test.

Read it with two questions: does the selection cover the key texts of each chapter of the History, and are the excluded treatises precisely those hardest to fit into intellectual history? These questions test its scholarly value better than completeness.

review.title_zh: 把围棋放回生活世界：读《围棋与中国文化》
review.title_en: Putting Go back into the lifeworld
review.standfirst_zh: 与《思想史》《弈境》构成三面：一本讲观念，一本讲文艺，这本讲棋人、制度、传播与雅俗。
review.standfirst_en: With the History and The Realm of Play it forms a triptych: ideas, art, and here players, institutions, transmission and the elite/popular divide.
review.body_zh:
《围棋与中国文化》在何云波的三本主干中，承担的是「文化」这一面。若《思想史》处理观念，《弈境》处理文艺，本书则把围棋放回生活世界：棋人、制度、文艺与传播。

它的纲领可以在同期文章中找到：「在某种意义上，围棋成了中国思想与文化的一个标本、一种象征。」这句话既是文化研究的宣言，也暴露了风险：当「文化」涵盖太广，每一层都可能只停留在举例。

因此，读它时应把「文化」拆成四层：棋人（谁在下）、制度（在什么框架下下）、文艺（如何被表现）、传播（如何跨地域流动）。逐层问：本书提供了哪类证据？如果某一层只有例子而没有论证，它就更像文化常识，而非文化史。这个判断，比「内容全不全」更能检验它的价值。
review.abstract_en:
Among He Yunbo's three main Go books, Go and Chinese Culture carries the cultural side. If the History treats ideas and The Realm of Play treats art, this book returns Go to the lifeworld: players, institutions, literature/art and transmission.

Its programme appears in his article: 'in a sense, Go became a specimen and symbol of Chinese thought and culture.' That is a manifesto for cultural studies, and it also exposes the risk: when 'culture' is broad, each layer may remain at the level of example.

Read it by splitting culture into four layers: players (who plays), institutions (under what framework), literature/art (how it is represented) and transmission (how it travels). Ask what evidence each layer gets. If a layer has examples but no argument, it is cultural common sense rather than cultural history. That judgment tests the book better than completeness.

background.zh:
何云波所著，书名以「弈境」标出围棋的境界问题；与《围棋与中国文化》《中国围棋思想史》构成其三本主干。

background.en:
By He Yunbo, its title foregrounds the question of realm (jing) in Go; with Go and Chinese Culture and the History it forms a trilogy of sorts.

The 'skill into the Way' section of He's article uses Shi Ding'an's Yili Zhigui — 'steps, form, meaning, spirit' — to show how skill deepens. That classical case is a useful anchor for checking the book's skill–art–realm argument (article ≠ book; ◐).

narrative.zh:
据书名与作者论述线索，本书把围棋放进中国文艺精神（诗、书、画、琴）的谱系中，讨论「技进乎道」如何在审美层面成立。章节结构待核。

若本书确实处理「弈境」，应能回答：「境」是审美范畴、伦理境界，还是棋力层级？三者各有古典来源，不可混用。
narrative.en:
Judging by title and the author's line, it places Go within the genealogy of Chinese literary-artistic spirit (poetry, calligraphy, painting, qin) and asks how 'skill into the Way' works aesthetically. Structure pending.

If the book does treat 'realm', it should answer whether realm is aesthetic, ethical or a rank of playing strength; the three have different classical sources and must not be conflated.

author_intent.claim_zh: 何云波要证明：围棋与中国文艺精神共享同一套范畴（艺、道、文、言、境），因此围棋不只是「技艺」，而是「文艺」；方法是以古典文论的概念去读棋论与棋事，而不是反过来用棋理附会文论。
author_intent.claim_en: He wants to show that Go and the Chinese literary-artistic spirit share one set of categories — art, Way, literature, language, realm — so Go is not merely a technique but an art; the method is to read Go discourse through classical poetics, not to force literature onto Go.
author_intent.why_zh: 五章的结构本身就是论证：从「弈与艺」建立合法性，到「弈与道」处理技进乎道，再到「弈与文」「思与言」，最后收于「游戏精神与艺术精神」；「诗境与弈境」「手谈与对话」「弈境与艺境」三组并置，说明作者要的是范畴的互通，而不是单方面的比附。
author_intent.why_en: The five-chapter structure is the argument: legitimacy in Go and art, then skill-into-Way, then literature and language, closing on play and artistic spirit; the paired terms poetic realm/Go realm, hand-talk/dialogue, Go realm/artistic realm show he wants categories to travel both ways.

review.title_zh: 让范畴双向通行：读《弈境》的五章结构
review.standfirst_zh: 一部把围棋放进中国文艺精神谱系的著作：它要证明「弈」与「艺、道、文、言、境」共享同一套范畴。
review.standfirst_en: A book that places Go within the Chinese literary-artistic genealogy, arguing that Go shares one set of categories with art, the Way, literature, language and realm.
review.body_zh:
《弈境》的结构本身就是论证。第一章「弈与艺」先把围棋放进「艺」的知识谱系，回答「围棋凭什么算艺术」；第二章「弈与道」从「周天画地」「制胜保德」到「技进乎道」，处理技艺如何上升为道；第三章「弈与文」以「弈与文通」「诗境与弈境」「小说与围棋」让棋与文互证；第四章「思与言」在「道与术」「玄象与数理」「雅俗之间」展开；第五章「游戏精神与艺术精神」收于「手谈与对话」「弈境与艺境」。

这套结构的关键，是「境」字的双重性：它既是审美境界，也是棋局与棋力的境界。作者要证明围棋与中国文论共享同一套范畴，因此不能只把围棋当胜负之术。最强的反读是：这更像「以围棋为案例的中国文论研究」，而不是围棋本体论；「境」的多义也可能被文论框架统一掉。

由于书已下架、未读全文，本文只判断其架构。就架构而言，它的贡献是给「技—艺—道」提供了一条可操作的范畴链；它的风险是把棋论的技术语境读成美学寓言。读者应带着这两个警觉去读：哪些章节真的让范畴双向通行，哪些只是把文论词汇套在棋上。
review.abstract_en:
The structure of The Realm of Play is itself the argument. Chapter one places Go within the genealogy of the arts and asks why Go counts as art; chapter two moves from cosmological framing and strategic virtue to skill-into-Way; chapter three pairs Go with literature through the shared language of composition, poetic realm and the Go realm, and the novel; chapter four works through the Way and technique, cosmological symbolism and number, and the elite/popular divide; chapter five closes on play and artistic spirit, hand-talk and dialogue, the Go realm and the artistic realm.

The pivot is the polysemy of 'realm': it is at once an aesthetic state, a position in a game and a level of strength. He wants to show that Go and Chinese poetics share categories, so Go cannot be reduced to a technique of winning. The strongest counter-reading is that this is a study of Chinese literary theory with Go as its case, not an ontology of Go; the poetic frame may unify the senses of realm and let Go's technicality recede.

Since the book is delisted and unread here, this essay judges only the architecture. As architecture, its contribution is an operational chain from skill to art to the Way; its risk is turning technical Go discourse into aesthetic allegory. The reader should ask, chapter by chapter, where the categories genuinely travel both ways and where poetic vocabulary is simply laid over the board.

author_intent.claim_zh: 吴清源要提出一套非竞争本位的棋道：围棋的目标不是胜负，而是在每一手寻找阴阳平衡的「中」；「中和」既是棋理，也是他的人生态度。
author_intent.claim_en: Wu wants a non-competitive Way of Go: the aim is not victory but finding the yin-yang balance point in each move; equilibrium is at once Go theory and a stance toward life.
author_intent.why_zh: 第一章给出三个可引命题：他从不把围棋当作胜负；「中」是阴阳平衡的那一点；「与其说围棋是竞争和胜负，不如说围棋是和谐」。他又把「中」落到「正着」与「生存权」，并用四书与《易经》说明其修养来源，说明这不是修辞，而是有古典依据的主张。
author_intent.why_en: Chapter one gives three quotable propositions: he never treats Go as victory; the middle is the yin-yang balance point; Go is harmony rather than competition. He grounds the middle in the correct move and the right to survive, and cites the Four Books and I Ching as the source of his cultivation, showing a classical basis rather than rhetoric.

evidence.zh: 2001 日本连载、2003 中译、2010 中信版，说明其自述有长期建构过程。
evidence.en: Serialised 2001, translated 2003, CITIC 2010: the self-account was built over time.

author_intent.counter_zh: 另一种读法：这是棋手晚年的自我理想化，「中和」是对一生胜负生涯的回顾性调和；它未必是一套可操作的棋学，而是一种人生态度的表达。若如此，「中和」的棋理含义应被弱化。
author_intent.counter_en: Alternative reading: this is a late-life self-idealisation, and equilibrium retrospectively harmonises a career of fierce competition; it may be a stance toward life rather than an operational Go theory. On that reading, the technical sense of equilibrium should be weakened.
author_intent.boundary_zh: 仅读第一章，无法判断全书是否把「中和」贯彻到布局、全局与具体棋局；上述推断依据第一章、何云波转引与生卒资料，推断本身标 ◐。
author_intent.boundary_en: With only chapter one, I cannot tell whether the book carries equilibrium into opening, whole-board and concrete play; the inference rests on chapter one, He's citation and biographical data, and is marked ◐.

review.title_zh: 「中」的那一点：读吴清源《中的精神》
review.standfirst_zh: 棋手本人的棋道自述：不是旁观者解释围棋，而是吴清源用「中和」说明如何在一局棋里寻找阴阳平衡。
review.standfirst_en: The player's own account of the Way: not an outsider explaining Go, but Wu using equilibrium to say how he seeks yin-yang balance within a game.
review.body_zh:
《中的精神》是吴清源的自传，但它最重要的部分不是生平，而是他用「中和」「调和」给棋道下的定义。第一章《中和》从重访哈尔滨写起，随后给出三个可引的命题：他从不把围棋当作胜负；「中」是阴阳平衡的那一点；「与其说围棋是竞争和胜负，不如说围棋是和谐」。

这三句的力量在于它们来自棋手本人的经验，而不是旁观者的哲学解释。但它们也有边界：自传是回顾性的自我叙述，可能把一生的实践理想化；「中和」是吴清源的个人语汇，不能直接等同于儒家、道家或佛教的任一体系。读它时应把生平叙述与棋学命题分开：前者可核，后者是他本人的主张。

最值得追问的是「正着」：如果正着不是最强手，而是中和各子作用的那一点，那么围棋的「最优」就不再只是计算问题，而是局面关系的平衡。这一命题可以与何云波的「和谐之道」对读，也可以与 Cobb 的佛教路线对照：两者都超越胜负，但一个从阴阳平衡出发，一个从觉悟出发。
review.abstract_en:
The Spirit of the Middle is Wu Qingyuan's memoir, but its most important part is not the life story: it is his definition of the Way of Go through equilibrium and harmony. Chapter one begins with a return to Harbin and then offers three quotable propositions: he never treats Go as victory; the middle is the yin-yang balance point; Go is harmony rather than competition.

Their force lies in coming from a player's own experience rather than an outsider's philosophy. Their limit is equally clear: a memoir is retrospective self-narration and may idealise a life; equilibrium is Wu's personal idiom, not identical with any one of Confucianism, Daoism or Buddhism. Separate the biography, which can be checked, from the Go thesis, which is his own claim.

The most productive question is the 'correct move'. If it is not the strongest move but the one that harmonises the stones' roles, then optimality in Go is not merely calculation but balance of relations. That proposition can be read against He Yunbo's 'way of harmony' and against Cobb's Buddhist route: both go beyond winning, one from yin-yang balance, the other from enlightenment.

review.title_zh: 学棋与懂棋同路：读 Shotwell《Go! More Than a Game》
review.title_en: Learning the game and understanding it
review.standfirst_zh: 一本把教学局与围棋史、儒家论棋、电脑围棋并置的英文入门书。
review.standfirst_en: An English primer that sets teaching games beside Go history, Confucian writing and computer Go.
review.body_zh:
《Go! More Than a Game》的书名就是论点：围棋不止是游戏。Shotwell 的做法不是先讲文化再讲规则，而是把两者放在同一条路径上：教学局从 9×9 到 13×13 再到 19×19，文化章则穿插围棋史、儒家论棋、电脑围棋与组合博弈论。

这使它在英文入门书中比较特别：多数入门书只教规则，Shotwell 则要让读者在学棋的同时建立「围棋为什么重要」的背景。2011 版据早期围棋史与儒家论棋的新材料修订，说明这一文化维度不是装饰，而是持续更新的内容。

它的风险是比重：如果文化章过重，初学者可能被历史材料拖慢；如果过轻，「more than a game」就只是口号。读它时最好按所持版本（2003 修订或 2011）核对章节，并把「教学局」与「文化章」分开读：前者练手，后者建背景，两者不能互相替代。
review.abstract_en:
The title of Go! More Than a Game is the thesis: Go is more than a game. Shotwell does not postpone culture until after rules; he puts both on one path. Teaching games run from 9x9 to 13x13 to 19x19, while cultural chapters intersperse Go history, Confucian writing, computer Go and combinatorial game theory.

That makes it unusual among English primers: most teach rules only, while Shotwell wants the reader to build a background for why Go matters. The 2011 edition was revised with new material on early history and Confucian writing, showing the cultural dimension is updated rather than decorative.

The risk is balance: too much culture slows the beginner, too little makes 'more than a game' a slogan. Check the edition you hold (2003 revised or 2011), and read teaching games and cultural chapters separately: one trains the hand, the other builds background; neither substitutes for the other.

review.title_zh: 图解入门：读 Shotwell《Go Basics》
review.standfirst_zh: 一本纯入门的图解手册：600+ 图解、9×9 先行、受子解释与 AGA CD-ROM。
review.standfirst_en: A purely introductory illustrated handbook: 600+ diagrams, a 9x9 start, handicap explanation and an AGA CD-ROM.
review.body_zh:
《Go Basics》是 Shotwell 的第二本围棋手册，与《Go! More Than a Game》形成明确分工：后者把教学与文化史放在一起，前者则专注「让零基础读者尽快能下棋」。

它的教学设计很清楚：600+ 图解、从 9×9 入手、讲基本战术与取胜策略、解释受子制，并附美国围棋协会制作的 CD-ROM。所列策略是侵入、弃子、用劫、地域思维等实战条目，而不是历史或哲学章节。

它的局限也在这里：2005 年版未覆盖 AI 时代的围棋；随书 CD-ROM 在今天可能难以使用；文化维度较轻。读它时不要期待「围棋为什么重要」，而应把它当「图解词典」：先做 9×9 练习，再查受子与劫的条目。
review.abstract_en:
Go Basics is Shotwell's second Go handbook, clearly divided from Go! More Than a Game: the latter joins teaching and cultural history, while this one concentrates on getting a complete beginner to play.

The pedagogy is explicit: 600+ diagrams, a 9x9 start, basic tactics and winning strategy, handicap explanation and an AGA CD-ROM. The listed strategies are practical — invasion, sacrifice, ko, territory — not historical or philosophical chapters.

Its limits follow: the 2005 edition predates AI-era Go; the bundled CD-ROM may be hard to use today; culture is light. Do not expect 'why Go matters'; use it as an illustrated dictionary: do 9x9 drills first, then look up handicap and ko.

background.zh:
Fairbairn 与已故 T. Mark Hall 从 GoGoD 资料与各地棋书搜集文章，2009 年由 Slate and Shell 出版。BGJ 书评称全书 300 页，章节涉及开局、贴目、棋人、棋书、历史、现代围棋、业余与职业，并有关于战时日本围棋与原子弹对局的较长论述；另有两位客座作者。

BGJ 书评列出的章节包括：开局、贴目、棋人、棋书、「sexy sekis」、历史、现代围棋、业余与职业；客座作者 Ivan Vigano 写日本盲人棋手，Pieter Mioch 写第 45 期十段与 2006 世界业余赛；并有一篇关于战时日本围棋与原子弹对局的较长论述。
background.en:
Fairbairn and the late T. Mark Hall assembled essays from GoGoD and Go bookshops; Slate and Shell published it in 2009. The BGJ review describes 300 pages on openings, komi, players, books, history, modern Go, amateur and professional play, with a long piece on wartime Japan and the atom-bomb game, plus two guest authors.

The BGJ review lists sections on the opening, komi, players, books, 'sexy sekis', history, modern Go, amateur and professional Go; guest authors Ivan Vigano (blind players in Japan) and Pieter Mioch (45th Judan and the 2006 World Amateur); plus a long piece on wartime Japan and the atom-bomb game.

review.title_zh: 把棋道放回历史：读《The Go Companion》
review.title_en: Putting the Way back into history
review.standfirst_zh: Fairbairn 与 Hall 的随笔集：从开局、贴目到棋人、棋书与战时日本，把围棋放回历史与文化。
review.standfirst_en: Fairbairn and Hall's collection: from opening and komi to players, books and wartime Japan, putting Go back into history and culture.
review.body_zh:
《The Go Companion》的书名就是方向：Go in History and Culture。它不是 Cobb 式的哲学文集，也不是技术手册，而是一本把围棋放回历史与文化的随笔集。

BGA 书评列出的章节很说明问题：开局、贴目、棋人、棋书、sexy sekis、历史、现代围棋、业余与职业；还有客座作者写日本盲人棋手、第 45 期十段与 2006 世界业余赛；以及一篇关于战时日本与原子弹对局的较长论述。这些题目共同构成一个判断：围棋的价值不在格言，而在具体人物、赛事与制度处境。

它的风险是「随笔集」的松散：长短文章并置，论证依赖多篇互补，而非一条主线。读它时最好按主题选取，而不是从头到尾；并把「棋道」类格言放回具体历史处境检验。这正是它与 Cobb 的分工：Cobb 谈观心，Fairbairn/Hall 谈历史。
review.abstract_en:
The title of The Go Companion is the direction: Go in History and Culture. It is neither Cobb-style philosophy nor a technical manual, but a collection that returns Go to history and culture.

The BGA review's sections are telling: opening, komi, players, books, sexy sekis, history, modern Go, amateur and professional; guest pieces on blind players in Japan, the 45th Judan and the 2006 World Amateur; and a long piece on wartime Japan and the atom-bomb game. Together they argue that Go's value lies in concrete persons, matches and institutions, not aphorism.

Its risk is the looseness of a collection: long and short pieces coexist and the case is cumulative rather than a single line. Read by topic rather than straight through, and test 'Way' aphorisms against concrete historical situations. This is its division of labour with Cobb: Cobb contemplates, Fairbairn and Hall historicise.

books.why_zh: 为「棋道」提供社会科学对照：不教人借围棋观心，而是观察人们如何给围棋赋予道德、性别与民族意义。
books.why_en: A social-science counterweight to 'the Way': it does not teach contemplation through Go but observes how people give Go moral, gendered and national meaning.

background.zh:
Moskowitz 以民族志方法研究中国围棋，讨论围棋与人格塑造、儒家形象、男性气质、阶层、民族认同及现代性的关系。它属于「人们在围棋上做什么」的研究，而非「围棋是什么」的哲学。

摘要层面可核的框架：围棋与人格塑造、儒家形象、男性气质、阶层、民族认同及现代性；方法为民族志（田野与访谈）。它问的是「人们如何赋予围棋意义」，不是「围棋本身是什么」。
background.en:
Moskowitz studies Chinese weiqi ethnographically, discussing Go's relation to personhood, Confucian imagery, masculinity, class, national identity and modernity. It asks what people do with Go, not what Go is philosophically.

At the abstract level: Go's relation to personhood, Confucian imagery, masculinity, class, national identity and modernity, via ethnographic fieldwork and interviews. It asks how people give Go meaning, not what Go is.

Ethnographic structure: chapters built from fieldwork and interviews around masculinity, class and national imagination. Chapters await the book.

Chapters likely organise around masculinity, class and national imagination; fieldwork sites, sample and structure await the book.

review.title_zh: 围棋作为意义的场域：读《Go Nation》
review.title_en: Go as a field of meaning
review.standfirst_zh: 一部围棋人类学：它不教「观心」，而观察中国人如何用围棋生产男性气质、阶层与民族认同。
review.standfirst_en: An anthropology of Go: not teaching contemplation but observing how Chinese players produce masculinity, class and national identity through Go.
review.body_zh:
《Go Nation》的书名把三个词放在一起：国族、男性气质、围棋。这不是一本「棋道」书，而是一部围棋人类学：它问的不是「围棋是什么」，而是「人们在围棋上做什么」。

书目摘要列出的框架很清楚：围棋与人格塑造、儒家形象、男性气质、阶层、民族认同及现代性；方法为民族志（田野与访谈）。这使它与何云波的文化史形成对照：何云波处理文本与观念，Moskowitz 处理人群与实践。

它的风险在方法与证据：田野地点、样本规模与访谈方法未知，正文未读（出版社页 403），因此无法判断各范畴的论证比例。读它时最好把它当「社会科学的对照」，而不是「围棋哲学的替代」：它提醒我们，那些被哲学化的「棋道」说法，在具体人群里如何被使用、争夺与改写。
review.abstract_en:
Go Nation puts three words together: nation, masculinities and weiqi. This is not a book about the Way of Go but an anthropology of Go: it asks not what Go is but what people do with it.

The listed frame is clear: Go's relation to personhood, Confucian imagery, masculinity, class, national identity and modernity, via ethnographic fieldwork and interviews. This sets it against He Yunbo's cultural history: He works with texts and ideas, Moskowitz with people and practice.

The risk is method and evidence: fieldwork sites, sample size and interview method are unknown, and the body is unread (publisher page 403), so the weight of each category cannot be judged. Read it as a social-science counterweight, not a replacement for Go philosophy: it shows how philosophised claims about the Way are used, contested and rewritten by concrete groups.

author_intent.claim_zh: 《棋经十三篇》的意图不是写一本佛教修行书，而是把围棋放进宇宙论与伦理秩序：以棋局之数法天地阴阳，以「得算」「权舆」「合战」「虚实」「自知」构成从象数到实战、再到自我认识的论说链。
author_intent.claim_en: The Thirteen Chapters does not aim at a Buddhist manual; it places Go within cosmology and ethical order: the board's number figures heaven/earth and yin-yang, and calculation, opening, battle, emptiness/solidity and self-knowledge form a chain from number to practice to self-knowledge.
author_intent.why_zh: 开篇「夫万物之数，从一而起……白黑相半，以法阴阳」把棋局直接接到宇宙论；篇目从「棋局」到「得算」「权舆」「合战」「虚实」，是技术性的论说链；末以「自知」收束，说明作者关心的不只是胜负，而是棋手对自己的认识。三处结构共同指向「立象比德」而非「佛教修行」。
author_intent.why_en: The opening ties the board to cosmology through number and yin-yang; the chapters run from board to calculation, opening, battle and emptiness/solidity as a technical chain; the close on self-knowledge shows concern beyond winning. The structure points to imaging virtue, not Buddhist practice.

review.standfirst_en: The most cited Go theory text since the Song: it ties the board to cosmology and closes on self-knowledge.
review.body_zh:
《棋经十三篇》常被当作「围棋哲学」来引，但它首先是一部棋论。它的论说链很清楚：开篇以「万物之数，从一而起」「白黑相半，以法阴阳」把棋局接到宇宙论；随后以「得算」「权舆」「合战」「虚实」展开技术判断；末以「自知」收束，把棋艺与自我认识相连。

这条链条说明，它的意图不是「佛教修行」，而是「立象比德」：让棋局成为天地阴阳与伦理秩序的图像，同时不放弃技术性。它的风险也在这里：现代读者容易只引开篇的宇宙论，而忽略后面的技术篇目，把一个棋论读成哲学寓言。

由于十三篇全目与宋本原貌未核，本文只能判断其论说方向。最稳妥的读法是：先读开篇与「自知」，再读「得算」「权舆」「合战」「虚实」，看「象数」如何落地为「判断」。如果落地失败，它就只是宇宙论修辞；如果成功，它才是「技进乎道」的古典原型。
review.abstract_en:
The Thirteen Chapters is often quoted as Go philosophy, but it is first a Go treatise. Its chain is clear: the opening ties the board to cosmology through number and yin-yang; calculation, opening, battle and emptiness/solidity develop technical judgment; self-knowledge closes by linking Go to self-understanding.

That chain shows its intent is not Buddhist practice but imaging virtue: the board becomes an image of cosmic and ethical order without abandoning technique. The risk is the reverse: modern readers quote the cosmology and ignore the technical chapters, turning a treatise into allegory.

With the full chapter list and Song original unverified, this essay can judge only the direction. The safest reading is to take the opening and self-knowledge first, then calculation, opening, battle and emptiness/solidity, and see whether number actually lands in judgment. If it does not, the cosmology is rhetoric; if it does, this is the classical prototype of skill-into-Way.

sources.zh: 何云波《围棋与中国思想传统》（光明日报 2022-02-23）

review.title_zh: 存一代之文：读《忘忧清乐集》
review.title_en: Preserving the texts of an age
review.standfirst_zh: 南宋棋待诏的汇编：它把棋论与古谱放在一起，以「忘忧清乐」为围棋定调。
review.standfirst_en: A Southern Song imperial attendant's compilation: treatises and ancient records together, tuning Go to 'carefree joy'.
review.body_zh:
《忘忧清乐集》是南宋翰林院棋待诏李逸民编的围棋文献汇编。它的书名取自宋徽宗「忘忧清乐在枰棋」，这个选择很关键：编者把围棋放在「忘忧」的审美与生活世界，而不是宗教修行体系里。

它的内容也支持这一点：《棋经十三篇》《棋诀》《论棋诀要杂说》是棋论，孙策、晋武帝、明皇等古棋局是棋谱，两者合在一起，构成「论 + 谱」的双重证据。这不是一部「思想史」专著，而是一部可传承的经典汇编。

它的价值在保存，风险也在保存：汇编不提供统一论证，读者若只读现代解释，容易把「立象比德」当成原书宗旨，而忽略它首先是棋论与棋谱的集合。读它时最好先看目录，分清「论」与「谱」，再判断哪些是原文、哪些是后人的解释。
review.abstract_en:
The Carefree & Innocent Pastime Collection was compiled by Li Yimin, a Southern Song imperial Go attendant. Its title, from Huizong's line on carefree joy at the board, is decisive: the compiler places Go in a world of aesthetic life, not a system of religious practice.

The contents support this. The Thirteen Chapters, the Qijue and the Lun Qijue Ya Zashuo are treatises; the Sun Ce, Jin Emperor Wu and Ming Emperor records are game records; together they form a double evidence of discourse and record. This is not a work of intellectual history but a transmitted classic.

Its value is preservation, and so is its risk: a compilation offers no unified argument, and a reader who relies on modern interpretation may mistake imaging virtue for the book's purpose while ignoring that it is first a collection of treatises and records. Begin with the contents, separate discourse from record, and then decide what is primary text and what is later interpretation.

review.title_zh: 以题传法：读《玄玄棋经》
review.standfirst_zh: 中国古典死活题的集大成者：它用具名的题目与多解变式，训练记忆与判断。
review.standfirst_en: The great Chinese collection of classical life-and-death problems: named problems and multiple variations train memory and judgment.
review.body_zh:
《玄玄棋经》是传世的死活题集，Fairbairn 称其为「the most influential go book ever produced」。这个评价有具体依据：每题具名，名称含典故与解法提示；同一题有多解与变式；现代整理版以约 70 个主题索引，形成可检索的谱系。

这三点都指向「训练」而非「论证」：命名帮助记忆，变式训练判断，主题索引建立谱系。它不教人「借围棋观心」，而是教人「在题中识别模式」。把题集读成人生寓言，是对它的误读。

它的边界也很清楚：编纂者、成书年代与版本谱系未核；Fairbairn 的英文整理不等于原书面貌。读它时最好先做题，再看题名与解法；题名里的典故，往往就是古人留给后人的「提示」。
review.abstract_en:
The Gateway to All Marvels is a received collection of life-and-death problems, called by Fairbairn 'the most influential go book ever produced'. The judgment has concrete grounds: every problem is named, the names carrying allusions and hints; problems have multiple solutions and variations; the modern edition indexes about 70 themes into a searchable genealogy.

All three point to training rather than argument: names aid memory, variations train judgment, themes build a genealogy. It does not teach contemplation through Go; it teaches pattern recognition in problems. To read a problem collection as a life allegory is to misread it.

Its limits are clear: compiler, date and edition genealogy are unverified, and Fairbairn's English edition is not the original. Begin by solving, then read names and solutions; the allusions in the names are often the hints the ancients left.

background.zh: 由三篇 New Left Review 文章扩展而成，分别对应图（文类兴衰）、地图（文学地理）、树（演化与谱系）。它不是「理论」，而是一组可复用的模型。

narrative.zh: 三章三种模型：图把文类变成时间序列，地图把小说变成空间分布，树把形式变成演化谱系。每章都在回答同一个问题：不细读，还能看见什么？
narrative.en: Three chapters, three models: graphs turn genres into time series, maps turn novels into spatial distributions, trees turn forms into evolutionary lineages. Each asks: what can be seen without close reading?

review.body_zh:
《图、地图、树》由三篇 New Left Review 文章扩展而成，三章对应三种模型：图把文类变成时间序列，地图把小说变成空间分布，树把形式变成演化谱系。它不是一套统一理论，而是一组可复用的工具。

它的力量在于「换尺度」：不问一部作品意味着什么，而问一个文类为什么兴衰、小说如何在地图上流动、形式如何演化。它的风险也在这里：抽象会丢掉文本细部，三种模型之间也没有统一理论；2011 年的批评文集正是围绕这一点展开。

读它时最好把三种模型当作三种「问题装置」，而不是三种「答案」。它们能提出新问题，却不能替代历史解释。
review.abstract_en:
Graphs, Maps, Trees expands three New Left Review essays into three models: graphs turn genres into time series, maps turn novels into spatial distributions, trees turn forms into evolutionary lineages. It is not one theory but a set of reusable tools.

Its power is to change scale: not what a work means, but why a genre rises and falls, how novels move across maps, how forms evolve. Its risk is the same: abstraction loses texture, and the three models lack a unifying theory; the 2011 critical collection turns on this.

Read the three models as three question-devices, not three answers. They can pose new questions but cannot replace historical explanation.

review.title_zh: 把「不读」写成方法：读《远读》
review.standfirst_zh: 「远读」的命名之作：它不否认细读，而是把文学史推到文类、市场与世界的尺度。
review.standfirst_en: The book that named distant reading: it does not deny close reading but scales literary history to genre, market and world.
review.body_zh:
《远读》的书名就是纲领。Moretti 不否认细读，而是主张：当文学的数量超过任何人能读完的限度，文学史必须在文类、市场与世界的尺度上做。文集以《Conjectures on World Literature》开篇，用「屠宰场」讲文类的淘汰，再用「七千个标题」做量化的风格分析——三组文章共同把「不读」从贬义变成方法。

它的力量在于「换问题」：不问「这部作品意味着什么」，而问「这个文类为什么兴衰」「小说如何在地图上流动」「标题的长度说明了什么」。它的风险也在这里：可计量的语料本身受经典与市场选择影响，远读可能只是把「经典」换成「语料」，仍然由学者决定什么可读。

因此，读它时最好把「远读」当作一种补充而非替代：它能看见整体，却可能丢掉细部；它能提出新问题，却不一定能回答「这本书为什么好」。这两件事，应该同时成立。
review.abstract_en:
The title of Distant Reading is the programme. Moretti does not deny close reading; he argues that once literary production exceeds what anyone can read, literary history must work at the scale of genre, market and world. The collection opens with 'Conjectures on World Literature', uses the 'slaughterhouse' for genre selection and analyses seven thousand titles for style — together turning 'not reading' from insult into method.

Its power is to change the question: not what does this work mean, but why does this genre rise and fall, how does the novel move across maps, what does title length tell us. Its risk is the same: countable corpora are shaped by canon and market selection, and distant reading may merely replace the canon with a corpus still chosen by scholars.

Read it as a supplement, not a replacement: it sees wholes but may lose texture; it poses new questions but need not answer why a book is good. Both should hold at once.

review.title_zh: 用关键词写阶级：读《资产阶级》
review.standfirst_zh: 三部曲的收官：用「有用、舒适、效率、严肃」与「散文」，追踪资产阶级如何把形式变成自己的生活。
review.standfirst_en: The trilogy's close: useful, comfort, efficiency, seriousness and prose track how the bourgeoisie made form its life.
review.body_zh:
《The Bourgeois》是 Moretti「资产阶级三部曲」的收官。它不从一个阶级的意识形态口号开始，而从几个关键词开始：有用、舒适、效率、严肃；最后回到「散文」——资产阶级最典型的形式。

它的力量在于把「阶级」从口号变成可追踪的文学形式；它的风险也在这里：为什么是这几个词？它们能否代表整个阶级？「散文」是否只是一个文学理论的老问题？

读它时最好把关键词当作「线索」而非「结论」：每一个词都应该回到具体文本，看它如何出现、变形、消失。
review.abstract_en:
The Bourgeois closes Moretti's bourgeois trilogy. It does not start from a class ideology but from a few keywords — useful, comfort, efficiency, seriousness — and returns to prose, the bourgeoisie's most characteristic form.

Its power is to turn class from slogan into trackable literary form; its risk is the same: why these words, and can they stand for a whole class? Is prose merely an old problem of literary theory?

Read the keywords as clues rather than conclusions: each should return to concrete texts and be watched as it appears, mutates and disappears.

review.title_zh: 地图作为论证：读《欧洲小说地图》
review.standfirst_zh: Moretti 的文学地理代表作：一半画故事，一半画书；两种地图互相校正。
review.standfirst_en: Moretti's key work in literary geography: half maps stories, half maps books; the two correct each other.
review.body_zh:
《Atlas of the European Novel》把小说放进地图。它的双重论证很清楚：一半画「故事的地图」——奥斯汀的人物、巴尔扎克的地点；一半画「书的地图」——翻译、发行、图书馆。两种地图互相校正，避免文学地理变成单纯的背景考据。

它的力量在于把「空间」变成论证；它的风险也在这里：画什么、不画什么，本身就是选择；地图也可能只是把已知结论视觉化。

读它时最好把每张地图当作一个「论点」，问：这张图想证明什么？它没有画出的部分，是否同样重要？
review.abstract_en:
The Atlas of the European Novel puts the novel on the map. Its double argument is clear: half maps stories — Austen's characters, Balzac's places; half maps books — translation, distribution, libraries. The two correct each other, preventing literary geography from becoming mere background study.

Its power is to make space an argument; its risk is the same: what is mapped and not mapped is a choice, and maps may merely visualise known conclusions.

Read each map as a thesis: what does it argue, and is what it leaves unmapped equally important?

review.title_zh: 把远读做成手册：读《宏观分析》
review.title_en: Turning distant reading into a handbook
review.standfirst_zh: Jockers 的方法手册：语料、词频、主题模型与网络分析如何真正用于文学史。
review.standfirst_en: Jockers's methods handbook: how corpora, frequencies, topic models and networks actually work in literary history.
review.body_zh:
《Macroanalysis》把 Moretti 的「远读」纲领变成一套可操作的方法：先建语料，再做词频、主题模型、聚类与网络分析。它的目标不是提出一个新理论，而是让「百万书」尺度上的文学史可复现。

它的力量在于「可操作」；它的风险也在这里：统计聚类不等于文学解释，语料本身也受版权、数字化与经典选择影响。

读它时最好把每一种方法当作一个「可检验的步骤」：语料从哪来？参数如何选？结果如何解释？这三问答不上，宏观分析就只是统计展示。
review.abstract_en:
Macroanalysis turns Moretti's distant-reading programme into an operational method: build a corpus, then run word frequencies, topic models, clustering and network analysis. Its aim is not a new theory but a reproducible literary history at the scale of millions of books.

Its power is operability; its risk is that statistical clusters are not literary interpretation, and corpora are shaped by copyright, digitisation and canon.

Read each method as a testable step: where does the corpus come from, how are parameters chosen, how are results interpreted? Without these three answers, macroanalysis is statistical display.

review.title_zh: 尺度改变问题：读《远方的地平线》
review.standfirst_zh: 对远读的再反省：尺度不是中性的，量化也不等于客观。
review.standfirst_en: A reflection on distant reading: scale is not neutral, and quantification is not objectivity.
review.body_zh:
《Distant Horizons》不是又一本「远读宣言」，而是对远读的再反省。它的核心问题是：当我们把分析单位从一部作品换成一个世纪、一个文类、一个语料库，我们究竟看见了什么、又看不见什么？

它的力量在于把「尺度」写成证据问题，而不是技术问题；它的风险也在这里：对尺度的反省仍可能是实证主义的自我修补，模型不透明与语料偏差也仍在。

读它时最好把「量化」当作一种修辞而非保证：它能让某些模式可见，却不能自动给出解释。
review.abstract_en:
Distant Horizons is not another distant-reading manifesto but a reflection on it. Its core question: when the unit moves from a work to a century, a genre or a corpus, what exactly becomes visible and what disappears?

Its power is to treat scale as a problem of evidence rather than technique; its risk is that such reflection may remain positivist self-repair, with model opacity and corpus bias intact.

Read quantification as a rhetoric rather than a guarantee: it makes some patterns visible but does not automatically explain them.

review.title_zh: 把意义做进机制：读《制作深度游戏》
review.standfirst_zh: 一本把「意义」放回游戏设计中心的书：它要证明游戏可以处理悲伤、成瘾、孤独与死亡。
review.standfirst_en: A book that returns meaning to the centre of game design, arguing that games can address grief, addiction, loneliness and death.
review.body_zh:
《Making Deep Games》的书名就是一次转向：从「好玩」转向「有意义」。Rusch 不把「意义」当作主题标签，而是要求它通过机制被玩出来——玩家在规则与象征性行动中，经历那些无法被奖励穷尽的东西：悲伤、成瘾、孤独、死亡。

这与游戏研究的常见分工不同：Salen & Zimmerman 给规则—玩耍—文化的语法，Bogost 讲规则如何论证，Juul 讲规则与虚构的叠合；Rusch 则问：这些形式能不能承载一个人的存在经验？她的答案是把个人经验转化为可玩的系统，让玩家在安全距离内练习活着。

它的风险是「设计者中心」：深度由设计意图定义，玩家未必经历同样的意义；若没有玩家研究，「意义」仍可能停留在意图。读它时应把「设计意图」与「玩家经验」分开，并追问：哪一条机制真的承载了哪一段经验？
review.abstract_en:
The title of Making Deep Games marks a turn from fun to meaning. Rusch does not treat meaning as a theme label; she demands that it be played through mechanics — that players undergo, in rules and symbolic action, what rewards cannot exhaust: grief, addiction, loneliness, death.

This differs from the usual division of labour: Salen and Zimmerman supply the grammar of rules–play–culture, Bogost shows how rules argue, Juul shows the overlay of rules and fiction; Rusch asks whether these forms can carry a person's existential experience. Her answer is to turn personal experience into a playable system, letting players rehearse living at a safe distance.

The risk is designer-centrism: depth is defined by intent, and players may not undergo the same meaning; without player research, meaning may remain intent. Read it by separating design intent from player experience and asking which mechanic actually carries which experience.

review.title_zh: 三层语法：读《游戏规则》
review.standfirst_zh: 游戏设计的公共语法：规则、玩耍、文化，把设计从灵感变成可讨论的结构。
review.standfirst_en: The shared grammar of game design: rules, play and culture turn design from inspiration into discussable structure.
review.body_zh:
《Rules of Play》是游戏设计的经典教材。它的贡献是三层语法：规则（系统）—玩耍（经验）—文化（语境）。每一层都给出一组设计问题，让「设计」从灵感变成可讨论的结构。

它的力量在于「可教」；它的风险也在这里：以规则为中心，可能低估文化语境与玩家差异，把游戏压成系统。

读它时最好把三层当作「互相约束」而非「先后顺序」：规则塑造经验，经验又反过来改变规则的意义。
review.abstract_en:
Rules of Play is the classic game-design textbook. Its contribution is a three-layer grammar: rules (system), play (experience), culture (context). Each layer yields design questions, turning design from inspiration into discussable structure.

Its power is teachability; its risk is rule-centrism, which may underplay culture and player difference and reduce games to systems.

Read the three layers as mutually constraining rather than sequential: rules shape experience, and experience in turn changes what rules mean.

review.title_zh: 规则如何说服：读《说服性游戏》
review.standfirst_zh: 程序修辞：游戏的说服力不在文字，而在规则与流程。
review.standfirst_en: Procedural rhetoric: a game persuades through rules and processes, not words.
review.body_zh:
《Persuasive Games》提出「程序修辞」：游戏通过规则与流程说服，而不是通过文字。它把政治、广告与教育游戏放在一起，主张游戏有一种独立的表达形式。

它的力量在于给游戏研究一个可分析的单位：规则如何论证；它的风险也在这里：玩家未必把规则读成论证，作者也可能高估设计意图。

读它时最好把「程序修辞」当作一个假设：这个游戏的规则在论证什么？玩家是否真的经历了这个论证？
review.abstract_en:
Persuasive Games proposes procedural rhetoric: games persuade through rules and processes rather than words. It places political, advertising and educational games together, arguing that games have a distinct expressive form.

Its power is to give game studies an analysable unit: how rules argue; its risk is that players may not read rules as argument and the author may overestimate intent.

Read procedural rhetoric as a hypothesis: what does this game's rule system argue, and do players actually undergo that argument?

review.title_zh: 两层之间：读《半真实》
review.standfirst_zh: 游戏是「半真实」：玩家同时在真实规则与虚构世界两层行动。
review.standfirst_en: Games are half-real: players act in real rules and fictional worlds at once.
review.body_zh:
《Half-Real》提出一个简洁的本体论：游戏是「半真实」——玩家同时在真实规则与虚构世界两层行动。规则是真的（输赢、移动、限制），世界是虚构的（角色、故事、场景），意义正在两层之间。

它的力量在于给「规则 vs 叙事」之争一个折中；它的风险也在这里：两层未必能干净分开，定义也可能过度抽象。

读它时最好把「半真实」当作一个描述而非定义：它帮助我们看见两层，但不必把所有游戏都塞进同一个模型。
review.abstract_en:
Half-Real proposes a concise ontology: games are half-real — players act in real rules and fictional worlds at once. Rules are real (winning, moving, constraints), worlds are fictional (characters, stories, settings), and meaning lives between them.

Its power is to mediate the rules-versus-narrative debate; its risk is that the two layers may not be cleanly separable and the definition may be too abstract.

Read half-real as a description rather than a definition: it helps us see two layers without forcing every game into one model.

review.title_zh: 食物如何划分归属：读《美食民族主义》
review.standfirst_zh: 一个可操作的新概念：食物如何被用来决定「谁属于这里」——以及它为何同时可能是抵抗与排外。
review.standfirst_en: An operational new concept: how food is used to decide who belongs — and why it can be both resistance and exclusion.
review.body_zh:
《Gastronativism》的书名就是它的贡献：给「食物被用来划分归属」这一现象一个可操作的名字。Parasecoli 不把食物当作「文化」的装饰，而是当作划分共同体边界、动员政治、制造阶层的核心装置。

它的关键在于「双向」：同一套「本地食材、传统菜、文化遗产」的话语，既可能抵抗跨国资本、支持小生产者，也可能助长排外与民族主义。这让「美食民族主义」不只是一个批判标签，而是一个需要逐案判断的分析工具。

它的风险是概念过宽：并非所有「本地」都是民族主义，许多地方食物运动恰恰是反民族主义的。读它时应把「本地 pride」「文化遗产」「排外政治」三者分开，并追问：在具体案例里，哪一条线占主导？
review.abstract_en:
The title of Gastronativism is its contribution: it gives an operational name to the use of food in drawing belonging. Parasecoli treats food not as decoration on culture but as a core device for marking community boundaries, mobilising politics and producing class.

The key is its doubleness: the same discourse of local ingredients, traditional dishes and cultural heritage can resist transnational capital and support small producers, or feed xenophobia and nationalism. Gastronativism is therefore not only a critical label but an analytical tool requiring case-by-case judgment.

The risk is conceptual stretch: not all localism is nationalism, and many local food movements are anti-nationalist. Read it by separating local pride, cultural heritage and exclusionary politics, and asking which line dominates in a given case.

review.title_zh: 地方感是可以设计的：读《全球布鲁克林》
review.standfirst_zh: 一种跨国城市食物审美：粗木桌、爱迪生灯、单一产地咖啡——看似地方，实为全球流通。
review.standfirst_en: A transnational urban food aesthetic: rough wood, Edison bulbs, single-origin coffee — seemingly local, actually globally circulated.
review.body_zh:
《Global Brooklyn》提出一个可识别的审美标签：粗木桌、爱迪生灯、单一产地咖啡、酸面包。它在开普敦、孟买、哥本哈根、里约、特拉维夫同时出现，看似「地方」，实为全球流通。

它的力量在于把「地方感」写成设计效果；它的风险也在这里：一个标签可能压平不同城市的差异，也可能把中产消费风格误认为全球普遍。

读它时最好把每个城市案例当作一次「本地化策略」的检验：哪些元素被保留，哪些被替换，哪些被拒绝？
review.abstract_en:
Global Brooklyn names a recognisable aesthetic: rough wood, Edison bulbs, single-origin coffee, sourdough. It appears in Cape Town, Mumbai, Copenhagen, Rio and Tel Aviv — seemingly local, actually globally circulated.

Its power is to treat locality as a design effect; its risk is that one label may flatten differences across cities and mistake a middle-class style for a global condition.

Read each city as a test of localisation: which elements are kept, replaced or refused?

review.title_zh: 饺子作为问题：读《The Pierogi Problem》
review.standfirst_zh: 把「全球布鲁克林」的方法落到波兰：后社会主义一代如何重新发明「传统」食物。
review.standfirst_en: Lands the Global Brooklyn method in Poland: how a post-socialist generation reinvents traditional food.
review.body_zh:
《The Pierogi Problem》用一个具体食物命名全书：饺子。它要问的是，波兰的「传统食物」如何被新一代生产者、厨师与媒体重新发明，以回应全球化的「世界主义胃口」。

它的力量在于把「传统」写成被选择、包装、再销售的过程；它的风险也在这里：单一国家案例可能高估断裂、低估延续，三位作者的分工也需要核对。

读它时最好把「传统」拆成四层：原料、技术、叙事、市场。每一层都在被重新发明，但并非同时、同速。
review.abstract_en:
The Pierogi Problem names the book after one food. It asks how Polish traditional food is reinvented by a new generation of producers, chefs and media in response to cosmopolitan appetites.

Its power is to treat tradition as selected, packaged and resold; its risk is that a single-nation case may overstate rupture and understate continuity, and the three authors' division of labour needs checking.

Read tradition in four layers: ingredient, technique, narrative, market. Each is reinvented, but not at the same time or speed.

review.title_zh: 谁有权定义传统：读《知其来源》
review.title_en: Who has the right to define tradition
review.standfirst_zh: 原产地标签的文化政治：传统如何被法律化、市场化，并同时保护与排除生产者。
review.standfirst_en: The cultural politics of place-based labels: how tradition is legalised, marketed, and protects and excludes producers at once.
review.body_zh:
《Knowing Where It Comes From》研究原产地标签：地理标志、原产地命名、非物质遗产。它问的不是「什么才正宗」，而是「谁有权定义传统」。

它的力量在于把「传统」放进法律与市场文件，而不是停留在文化抒情；它的风险也在这里：多国比较可能牺牲单案深度，消费者视角也可能不足。

读它时最好把「标签」当作三件事的交汇：法律保护、市场区分、文化叙事。三者并不总是一致。
review.abstract_en:
Knowing Where It Comes From studies place-based labels: geographical indication, appellation, intangible heritage. It asks not what is authentic but who has the right to define tradition.

Its power is to place tradition in legal and market documents rather than cultural lyricism; its risk is that multi-country comparison may sacrifice depth, and the consumer view may be thin.

Read the label as the intersection of legal protection, market differentiation and cultural narrative. The three do not always align.

review.title_zh: 流动中的地方：读《大现代性》
review.standfirst_zh: 全球化不是同质化：五种「景观」在生产地方差异。
review.standfirst_en: Globalization is not homogenisation: five scapes produce local difference.
review.body_zh:
《Modernity at Large》提出五种「景观」：族群、媒体、技术、金融、意识形态。它们跨边界流动，又在地方被重新组合；因此全球化不是同质化，而是差异的生产。

它的力量在于给「全球/地方」一个可分析的中介层；它的风险也在这里：景观可能过于抽象，经验 grounding 不足。

读它时最好把每一种景观落到一个具体案例：食物、媒体或城市空间，看它如何被本地化。
review.abstract_en:
Modernity at Large proposes five scapes: ethnic, media, techno, finance and ideo. They flow across borders and are recombined locally, so globalization is not homogenisation but the production of difference.

Its power is to give the global/local an analysable middle layer; its risk is that scapes may be too abstract and empirically under-grounded.

Land each scape in a concrete case — food, media, urban space — and watch how it is localised.

review.title_zh: 两代人的一眼：读《知觉与记忆》
review.standfirst_zh: de Groot 与 Gobet 的跨代对话：棋手的专长是知觉与记忆，而非更深的搜索。
review.standfirst_en: A cross-generational dialogue between de Groot and Gobet: chess expertise is perceptual memory, not deeper search.
review.body_zh:
《Perception and Memory in Chess》把 de Groot 的经典研究与 Gobet 的组块理论放在同一本书里。它的核心命题是：棋手不是想得更多，而是看得不同；知觉与记忆才是专长的核心。

它最特别的地方，是第九章让两位作者以「两种不同观点」对话，保留分歧而不是制造共识。这让本书不仅是研究，也是一份学术争论的记录。

读它时最好把「一眼识别」当作可检验的假设：如果专长真是知觉，那么训练就应该改变「看」的方式，而不只是增加「想」的时间。
review.abstract_en:
Perception and Memory in Chess puts de Groot's classic research and Gobet's chunking theory in one book. Its core claim: masters do not think more but see differently; perception and memory are the core of expertise.

Its most distinctive feature is chapter nine, where the two authors stage 'two different views', preserving disagreement rather than manufacturing consensus. The book is thus both research and a record of scholarly debate.

Read 'seeing at a glance' as a testable hypothesis: if expertise is perceptual, training should change how one sees, not only how long one thinks.

review.title_zh: 不止国际象棋：读《心中的棋步》
review.standfirst_zh: 把棋类心理学扩展到围棋、将棋、跳棋：不同棋盘游戏共享哪些认知机制？
review.standfirst_en: Extends chess psychology to Go, shogi and checkers: which cognitive mechanisms do board games share?
review.body_zh:
《Moves in Mind》把「棋盘游戏」作为比较单位，而不是只看国际象棋。它先讲国际象棋的证据，再扩展到围棋、将棋等，最后讨论跨游戏的共同机制。

它的力量在于打破「国际象棋中心主义」；它的风险也在这里：多游戏比较可能牺牲单游戏深度，文化差异也可能被认知框架吸收。

读它时最好把「共享机制」当作可检验的假设：哪些结论能跨游戏迁移，哪些不能？
review.abstract_en:
Moves in Mind takes board games as the comparative unit rather than chess alone. It starts with chess evidence, extends to Go, shogi and others, and closes on shared mechanisms.

Its power is to break chess-centrism; its risk is that multi-game comparison may sacrifice depth and absorb cultural difference into a cognitive frame.

Read shared mechanisms as a testable hypothesis: which conclusions transfer across games, and which do not?

review.title_zh: 专家如何看：读《国际象棋心理学》
review.standfirst_zh: Gobet 的 12 章导论：从「职业眼光」到「组块」，再到练习、性别、直觉与心理战。
review.standfirst_en: Gobet's twelve-chapter introduction: from the professional eye to chunks, then practice, gender, intuition and psychological warfare.
review.body_zh:
《The Psychology of Chess》是一本 140 页的导论，却把棋类心理学的核心争论压缩成一条清晰的链：先问「是否需要天才」，再提出「职业眼光」与「组块」——专家不是想得更多，而是看得不同；随后用练习、性别、直觉、错误与心理战，展示这条链的边界。

它的力量在于「可读的争议」：组块理论、刻意练习与性别差异都不是定论，但 Gobet 让读者看见它们如何互相约束。它的风险也在「普及」：12 章的短篇会压缩限定条件，性别章与迁移章的论证需要回到《Moves in Mind》与论文核对。

读它时最好把「组块」当作一个可检验的假设：如果专家真是靠组块，那么训练就应该改变「看」的方式，而不只是增加「想」的时间。这个检验，比记住「组块」这个词更重要。
review.abstract_en:
The Psychology of Chess is a 140-page introduction that compresses the core debates of chess psychology into a clear chain: whether genius is needed, then the professional eye and chunks — experts see differently rather than think more — then practice, gender, intuition, error and psychological warfare as the chain's boundaries.

Its strength is readable controversy: chunking, deliberate practice and gender differences are not settled, but Gobet shows how they constrain one another. Its risk is the popular format: twelve short chapters compress qualifications, and the gender and transfer chapters need checking against Moves in Mind and the papers.

Read chunking as a testable hypothesis: if experts really rely on chunks, training should change how they see, not only how long they think. That test matters more than remembering the word.

review.title_zh: 一眼看出：读《思维与选择》
review.standfirst_zh: de Groot 的开山之作：用出声思维研究棋手如何选择着法，发现高手「一眼看出」而非穷举。
review.standfirst_en: de Groot's founding work: think-aloud studies of move choice show masters see at a glance rather than enumerate.
review.body_zh:
《Thought and Choice in Chess》是棋类心理学的开山之作。de Groot 用出声思维记录棋手如何选择着法，发现高手不是穷举，而是「一眼看出」局面的结构。

它的力量在于把「思维」变成可记录的语料；它的风险也在这里：出声思维可能改变思考，实验室任务也与真实对局有差距。

读它时最好把「一眼识别」当作一个可检验的假设：如果高手真是识别，那么训练就应该改变「看」的方式，而不只是增加「想」的时间。
review.abstract_en:
Thought and Choice in Chess is the founding work of chess psychology. de Groot used think-aloud protocols to record move choice and found that masters do not enumerate but see a position's structure at a glance.

Its power is to turn thought into recordable data; its risk is that think-aloud may alter thinking and lab tasks differ from real games.

Read 'seeing at a glance' as a testable hypothesis: if experts recognise, training should change how they see, not only how long they think.
